# ULTRAMETRICA

> Zero-dependency real-time discrete $p$-adic AdS/CFT (Bruhat-Tits tree) holography laboratory featuring rotating Tate-curve Kerr-BTZ quotients, Kozyrev wavelets, 48 kHz AudioWorklet sonification, and 148 audited pure Lean 4.35.0 Palomar `module` declarations about the discrete model (104 core theorems + 29 zero-Mathlib helper lemmas + 5 adversarial refutations + 10 isolated comparator bindings verified across 6 independent Lean kernels via `lake comparator --paranoid`; all 11 files < 1,000 lines). No physical, continuum, or quantum-gravity statement is proved, and no open problem is retired.

- Author: Alexander Stephen Donahue (Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA; ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`)

## FILE: `AGENTS.md`

# AGENTS.md — ULTRAMETRICA Engineering & Scientific Verification Guide

> Canonical agent instruction entry point (`A32` of Build Standard `v1.2.0`). `CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, and `.cursor/rules/build-standard.mdc` reference this file.

## 1. Project Identity & Scope

- **Project:** **ULTRAMETRICA** (`0thernes/ultrametrica`, `v1.6.0`) — zero-dependency real-time discrete $p$-adic AdS/CFT (Bruhat-Tits tree) holography laboratory featuring rotating Tate-curve Kerr-BTZ black hole quotients, Kozyrev wavelets, 48 kHz prime-power AudioWorklet sonification, and pure Lean 4 (`v4.35.0`) checked discrete model invariants.
- **Author & Affiliation:** Alexander Stephen Donahue (`Alexander S. Donahue`), ORCID [`0009-0006-8168-9648`](https://orcid.org/0009-0006-8168-9648), **Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA** (`0_0@0thernes.art`, `https://0thernes.art`, `https://github.com/0thernes`). Never assert `"0thernes LLC"` as a legal entity.
- **License:** `COSMOGONIC LICENSE — NON-COMMERCIAL RESEARCH & PLAY` ([`LICENSE`](LICENSE)). Keep attribution intact; see [`LEGAL.md`](LEGAL.md) and [`docs/adr/0005-cosmogonic-noncommercial-license.md`](docs/adr/0005-cosmogonic-noncommercial-license.md).

## 2. Hard Rules (Non-Negotiable — Build Standard R1–R8)

- **R1 — Solo Dev Ergonomics:** Never install git hooks, branch protection, commit/tag signing, or blocking lint/SAST/SBOM CI gates. Lint/type/secret checks in CI must remain **report-only** (`continue-on-error: true`).
- **R2 — Direct to `main`:** Commit and push directly to `main`. Zero PRs, zero feature branches, zero `.github/pull_request_template.md`.
- **R3 — Tests Block; Linters Report:** Functional, true source-code mutant, property, fuzz, concurrency, contract, golden, oracle, Lean 4 kernel/comparator, and Tectonic zero-warning PDF checks fail CI on broken invariants; style/static linters report without blocking.
- **R4 — No Banned Files:** Never add Dependabot, Renovate, PR templates, Copilot instructions, `FUNDING.yml`, or `CODEOWNERS`.
- **R5 — Ten-Class Finding Taxonomy:** Every audit or review finding MUST be tagged with one of the exact 10 classes: `bug`, `error`, `issue`, `problem`, `concern`, `dilemma`, `conflict`, `gap`, `hole`, `blindspot`.
- **R6 — Never Fabricate:** Never invent measurements, p-values, citations/DOIs, peer-review claims, or badges. Distinguish strictly between `kernel-checked`, `exact-rational`, `numerical`, `pre-registered statistical`, and `prior work` tiers; report Lean declarations honestly in four buckets (`104 core + 29 helpers + 5 adv + 10 isolated bindings = 148`) without double-counting comparator bindings.
- **R7 — Lean 4 Kernel Integrity:** Zero `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom`, `native_decide`, `unsafe`, `implemented_by`, or `@[extern` in `lean/UltrametricaProofs.lean`, `lean/UltrametricaProofs/*.lean`, and `lean/Solution.lean` (`lean/Challenge.lean` intentionally holds specification `sorry`s matched by `lake comparator --paranoid`). All audited axioms strictly inside `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`. Keep every `.lean` file `< 1,000` lines.
- **R8 — Preserve Author License & Identity:** Keep `LICENSE` and canonical ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648` synchronized everywhere.

| `test/` | `verify.mjs` (10 theorems), `mutants.mjs` (8 true source-code killed mutants), `properties.mjs` (3,400+ property/metamorphic/curved-BTZ Dijkstra stress cases), `server.mjs` (HTTP contract/realpath + EIO), `golden.mjs`, `fuzz.mjs` (1,000 B15 fuzz cases), `concurrency.mjs` (B19 HTTP + AudioWorklet VM storm) |

| `docs/` & root | `CLAIMS.md`, `LIMITATIONS.md`, `DEVIATIONS.md`, `REPLICATION.md`, `ERRATA.md`, `docs/{CLAIMS,MASTER_REPORT,AUDIT_AND_CONTRAST_ANALYSIS,MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK,LITERATURE_SEARCH,preregistration,statement-fidelity,architecture,benchmarks,threat-model,configuration,operations,faq,glossary,run-log}.md`, `docs/adr/`, `docs/reviews/` |

## 4. Exact Verification Commands

```bash
# 1. All 32 Node test suites (theorems + true source mutants + properties + server + golden + fuzz + concurrency)
npm run verify:all

# 2. Runnable examples + benchmarks + pre-registered statistics + discovery
npm run examples
npm run bench
npm run stats
npm run discover

# 3. Independent Python differential oracle, axiom/DOI/blueprint guards & exact-rational falsifier + checksums
python reference/padic_oracle.py
python scripts/check_readme_axioms.py
python scripts/check_citations.py --live
python scripts/check_blueprint.py
python scripts/verify_exact.py --check-checksums

# 4. Lean 4.35.0 full build, 148-declaration axiom audit, leanchecker & 6-kernel comparator
cd lean
lake clean && lake build UltrametricaProofs Challenge Solution
lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean
lake env leanchecker --fresh UltrametricaProofs
lake env leanchecker --fresh Solution
lake check --paranoid                                  # Ubuntu/Linux with bubblewrap
lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid    # Ubuntu/Linux with bubblewrap

# 5. White paper figures, zero-warning PDF, and standalone arXiv check
python scripts/generate_figures.py
python scripts/package_dist.py

# 6. Build Standard v1.2.0 90-item repo audit
pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/Audit-Repo.ps1 -Path .   # Windows
bash scripts/audit-repo.sh .                           # Linux/macOS
```

## 5. Known Technical Traps

1. **PowerShell Bracket Paths:** On Windows dev machines with literal brackets in parent paths (e.g. `Z:\[Vibe Coded (AI)]\...`), always use `-LiteralPath` in PowerShell file cmdlets.
2. **LF Line Endings & SHA-256:** `CHECKSUMS.sha256` and `data/MANIFEST.sha256` hash exact bytes; preserve Unix `LF` (`\n`) endings on all text files (enforced by `.editorconfig` and `.gitattributes`).
3. **HTTP Keep-Alive, `headersSent` & `realpath`:** In `server.mjs`, always verify `realpath` confinement and `await fsImpl.readFile(...)` *before* calling `res.writeHead(200, ...)` on `GET`, and close keep-alive sockets in tests via `agent: false` + `server.closeAllConnections?.()`.
4. **Child `node --test` Inside `node --test`:** When spawning child `node --test` processes from a test file (as in `test/mutants.mjs`), always delete `NODE_TEST_CONTEXT` from the child environment or Node will silently skip reporting test failures.
5. **Finite-Cutoff Boundary Edges on $T_p$:** Theorem V / V-Global holds on strictly interior edges whose endpoints both have full degree $p + 1$; finite cutoff trees have root degree $p$ (depth $0$) and leaf degree $1$ (depth $n$), so interior perturbations require `nodeDepth[u] >= 2 && nodeDepth[v] <= n - 2` (`n >= 4`).
6. **Pre-Registration Discipline:** Never edit historical committed sections of `docs/preregistration.md` retroactively; log any exploratory post-registration extensions transparently in `DEVIATIONS.md` and `docs/preregistration.md` §3.

## FILE: `README.md`

# ULTRAMETRICA

> **A zero-dependency, real-time laboratory for a discrete $p$-adic AdS/CFT (Bruhat-Tits tree) holography model: Tate-curve BTZ quotients with horizon flux, adelic parity symmetries, Ollivier-Ricci curvature and Gauss-Bonnet charge identities, graph-cut strong subadditivity, 48 kHz prime-power AudioWorklet sonification, and 148 audited zero-Mathlib Lean 4 (`v4.35.0`, Palomar `module`) declarations about the discrete model.** All 148 declarations are kernel-checked by Lean (`lake build`, `leanchecker`, and Ubuntu CI `lake check --paranoid`); the 10 isolated comparator targets in [`lean/comparator.json`](lean/comparator.json) (and their dependency closure) are also checked across 6 independent kernels via `lake comparator --paranoid` in Ubuntu CI. No physical, continuum, or quantum-gravity statement is proved, and no open problem is retired.

> **Statement-audit alignment (`2026-11-26`, integrated in `v1.6.0`):** Following the independent 2026-11-26 statement audit ([`ERRATA.md`](ERRATA.md), [audit log](https://github.com/0thernes/0thernes-research-archive/blob/main/docs/reviews/2026-11-26-statement-audit.md)), `"Quantum Gravity"` and `"Unconditional"` wording have been withdrawn across code, paper, and docs, every headline claim below separates what Lean proves from what rests on exact-rational, numerical, or paper-level checks, and `v1.6.0` directly resolved the formal issues flagged in that audit (adding kernel-verified primal entry non-negativity to `gen_bridge_primal_sub/sup_optimal`, quantifying `even_prime_self_conjugate`, removing `rt_odd_prime_horizon_dominance`, strengthening `Challenge.lean` Targets 1/3/5/7/10, and updating `paper/main.tex` and Lean docstrings).

## 5-Second Independent Proof Verification (`#print axioms` & Multi-Kernel Audit)

Verify all **148 audited pure Lean 4 (`v4.35.0`, Palomar `module`) declarations** across 6 proof modules (`< 1,000` lines each, zero Mathlib, `autoImplicit = false`, no `sorry` outside the statement-only `Challenge.lean`, zero `native_decide`) — transparently accounted with **zero double-counting** as **104 core theorems & corollaries**, **29 zero-Mathlib helper lemmas**, **5 adversarial false-variant refutations** (`AdversarialTests.lean`), and **10 isolated `Spec`/`Challenge`/`Solution` comparator bindings** (standalone re-verifications of the headline targets from pure `Spec.lean`, never double-counted as separate mathematical discoveries). Seven small `CInt` helper lemmas (`add_smul`, `add_zero_left`, `add_zero_right`, `int_sq_nonneg`, `normSq_nonneg`, `normSq_zero`, `smul_zero`) are not listed separately in `VerifyAxioms.lean` and are transitively checked via the audited theorems invoking them:

```bash
cd lean && lake build UltrametricaProofs Challenge Solution && lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean
# On Linux with bubblewrap (also enforced on every push in GitHub Actions CI):
lake check --paranoid && lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid
```

Verbatim kernel output (character-checked against [`results/lean4-audit.txt`](results/lean4-audit.txt) by [`scripts/check_readme_axioms.py`](scripts/check_readme_axioms.py)):

```text
'Ultrametrica.monna_involution_universal' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'Ultrametrica.odd_prime_conjugate_sector_disjoint' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
'Ultrametrica.picket_fence_even_gap' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
'Ultrametrica.btz_kappa_from_wasserstein' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
'Ultrametrica.gen_bridge_wasserstein_lower_bound_sub' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
'Ultrametrica.gen_bridge_primal_sub_optimal' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'Ultrametrica.global_multi_edge_vertex_charge_conservation' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
'Ultrametrica.rt_strong_subadditivity' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
'Ultrametrica.multi_ball_kozyrev_soliton_list' depends on axioms: [propext]
'Ultrametrica.sherman_morrison_exact_identity' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
'Ultrametrica.Adversarial.adv_rt_ssa_reverse_inequality_false' does not depend on any axioms
'Ultrametrica.ComparatorTarget.target_thm5_kantorovich_dual' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'Ultrametrica.ComparatorTarget.target_adversarial_refutations' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
```

All 148 declarations are kernel-checked by Lean (`lake build`, `leanchecker --fresh`), and Ubuntu GitHub Actions CI additionally enforces `lake check --paranoid` on the full package plus 6-kernel `lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid` (`lean4`, `leanchecker`, `lean4lean`, `con-leche`, `con-ron`, `nanoda_bin` inside a Linux `bubblewrap` sandbox) across the **10 isolated comparator targets and their dependency closure**. See [`docs/statement-fidelity.md`](docs/statement-fidelity.md) and the live **[Interactive Proof Blueprint](https://0thernes.github.io/ultrametrica/web/blueprint.html)**.

## Six Core Results: What Lean Proves and What Is Checked Otherwise

Each result below separates its kernel-checked Lean 4 part (concerning the repository's own discrete definitions) from the exact-rational (`scripts/verify_exact.py`), numerical (`32` Node suites, `8/8` real source mutants, `1,000+` Python oracle queries), or pre-registered statistical checks. Row-by-row detail is in [`CLAIMS.md`](CLAIMS.md) and [`docs/statement-fidelity.md`](docs/statement-fidelity.md).

1. **Theorem I & Prop. 4.2 — Monna digit reversal, valuation-residue sectors & modular picket-fence law** ([`Basic.lean`](lean/UltrametricaProofs/Basic.lean), [`AdelicSymmetry.lean`](lean/UltrametricaProofs/AdelicSymmetry.lean), [`docs/preregistration.md`](docs/preregistration.md)):
   *Lean:* universal base-$p$ Monna digit-reversal involution, bijectivity, and ball contiguity ($p \ge 2, x < p^n$; formalizing Monna 1970); subtree-shift ultrametric prefix preservation; sector-index separation $m \ne p - m$ for odd $p$, $1 \le m < p$, and quantified $\forall m, 1 \le m < 2 \to m = 2 - m$ at $p = 2$; monotonicity and alternating gaps $p - 2m, 2m$ of the closed-form folded-frequency sequence `picketSeq`.
   *Not in Lean:* $H_\theta$ and $D_p^\alpha$ are not defined in Lean. Block diagonalization of $H_\theta$ into $1 + n(p-1)$ sectors $W_{s,m}$ (`leak <= 1.8e-14` up to $N = 625$), odd-prime doublet counts vs. $p = 2$ lifting, and the link between `picketSeq` and eigenvalues are verified via exact-rational and floating-point checks. Pre-registered Experiment I (`20` seeds vs. GUE/GOE controls; sensitivity extensions logged in [`DEVIATIONS.md`](DEVIATIONS.md)) confirms all **4/4 hypotheses** at primary `p_holm = 0.0004`, Mann-Whitney $p \le 4.8\times 10^{-7}$, non-pseudoreplicated matrix-level Wilcoxon `p_holm = 7.63e-6` (`20/20` seeds each, 95% bootstrap CIs for all 3 effect sizes excluding `0`), locking sectors near $r_0(p,m) = \min(2m, p-2m)/\max(2m, p-2m)$ ($W_{0,1} \approx 2/3$ vs. sibling $W_{0,2} \approx 1/4$ at $p=5, N=625$).
2. **Theorem II — Tate-curve BTZ Ollivier-Ricci law & $L_c = 5$ trichotomy** ([`HolographyCurvature.lean`](lean/UltrametricaProofs/HolographyCurvature.lean)):
   *Lean:* for the hand-coded 3-class reduction of horizon neighborhoods (`opp`, `back`, `child`, masses $M, M, pM$; class distances checked against cycle offsets by `btz_graph_metric_eq_classDist`), every non-negative coupling costs at least $M(3p + 2 - \max(0, 6-L))$ and an explicit feasible non-negative primal plan attains equality (both sides frozen in `Challenge.lean` Target 3), yielding $\kappa_{\mathrm{BTZ}}(p, L) = -(2p - \max(0, 6-L))/(p+2)$ for all $p \ge 2, L \ge 3$ in the reduced model.
   *Not in Lean:* the symmetry reduction from full neighbor-set couplings to 3-class couplings is a paper-level argument, cross-checked with zero rounding error across `45` full-graph exact `Fraction` horizons (`verify_exact.py`).
3. **Theorem III — Disjoint Kozyrev packets & pointwise nonlinearity splitting** ([`SolitonAndSolver.lean`](lean/UltrametricaProofs/SolitonAndSolver.lean)):
   *Lean:* over $\mathbb{Z}[i]$, for any finite list of pairwise-disjoint constant-modulus packets $\psi_r$ and any $F : \mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{Z}$, $F(|\sum_r \psi_r|^2)\sum_r \psi_r = \sum_r F(c_r)\psi_r$ pointwise; `kozyrev_exact_nonlinear_soliton` takes an abstract operator $D$ with an assumed eigenfunction property.
   *Not in Lean:* $D_p^\alpha$, Kozyrev wavelets, and PDE time evolution are not defined in Lean; radiation-free compacton-soliton dynamics (`0.00%` leakage up to $g = 500$) and $\alpha$-scaled multi-scale self-trapping are paper arguments checked numerically (Exp C & F).
4. **Theorem IV — Positive-definite Rank-1 Kerr-BTZ bulk solver, flux parity & BF stability margin** ([`SolitonAndSolver.lean`](lean/UltrametricaProofs/SolitonAndSolver.lean)):
   *Lean:* $w_{L-1} u u^\dagger \succeq 0$ quadratic expansion, the integer inequality $1 \le 1 + wq$ under explicit hypotheses $w \ge 0, q \ge 0$ (`sherman_morrison_denominator_ge_one`; holds when $T \succ 0$), an abstract arbitrary-dimension $L$ cleared-denominator complex Hermitian Sherman-Morrison identity (frozen in `Challenge.lean` Target 5), and edge-level flux parity $E(-\Omega) = E(\Omega), J(-\Omega) = -J(\Omega)$.
   *Not in Lean:* the $O(V)$ Schur-complement solver, positivity of $T$, and BF stability down to $\Delta = 0.5001, \Omega = \pi$ (`5.38e-15` residual) are checked via exact $\mathbb{Q}(i)$ Python verification (residual $= 0$) and numerical suites (Exp D & H).
5. **Theorems V & V-Global — Single-edge & multi-edge curved AdS discrete Gauss-Bonnet charge identities** ([`HolographyCurvature.lean`](lean/UltrametricaProofs/HolographyCurvature.lean), [`MultiEdgeHolography.lean`](lean/UltrametricaProofs/MultiEdgeHolography.lean)):
   *Lean:* for the reduced arbitrary-degree bridge-edge transport cost model (`genBridgeTransportCost`), universal subcritical and supercritical Kantorovich lower bounds hold and explicit **kernel-verified non-negative** feasible primal plans attain exact equality in BOTH regimes (closed in `v1.6.0` and frozen in `Challenge.lean` Target 7); `curved_gen_kappa_charge_decomp` splits curvature into vertex half-charges minus deficit; and `global_multi_edge_vertex_charge_conservation` proves per-vertex conservation $\sum -(p-1)w_e/W_u = -(p-1)$ over arbitrary positive-sum integer weight lists.
   *Not in Lean:* no Lean theorem sums curvature over the edges of an explicit finite tree; the global zero-excess / negative-deficit sum ($-2\sum \max(0, w_e/W_u + w_e/W_v - 1)$) is a paper-level assembly cross-checked over `69` single/multi-edge exact `Fraction` plans and `1,000` random JS trees (`< 1e-11`).
6. **Theorem VI — Graph-cut strong subadditivity** ([`MultiEdgeHolography.lean`](lean/UltrametricaProofs/MultiEdgeHolography.lean)):
   *Lean:* on arbitrary finite `Nat`-weighted edge lists and `Bool` vertex sets, for disjoint boundary regions $A, C$, $S(A \cup B \cup C) + S(B) \le \mathrm{cap}(W_{AB}) + \mathrm{cap}(W_{BC})$ for all homologous cuts $W_{AB}, W_{BC}$, under the explicit hypotheses that $S(A \cup B \cup C)$ and $S(B)$ lower-bound homologous cut capacities. Discrete formalization of Headrick & Takayanagi (Phys. Rev. D 76, 106013, 2007; no priority claimed), checked over `4,352` exhaustive brute-force partitions and `1,000` random JS graphs.

---

## Quickstart

Requires **Node.js $\ge 20$** (zero `npm install` needed — zero external runtime dependencies). Optional toolchains: Python `3.11+` (stdlib only), Lean `v4.35.0`, Tectonic `0.15+`.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/0thernes/ultrametrica.git
cd ultrametrica
npm run verify:all
```

## Usage

```bash
# 1. Run all 32 Node test suites (10 theorems, 8/8 real source mutants, 3,400+ properties, 1,000 fuzz, 3 concurrency/AudioWorklet race, server EIO, golden)
npm run verify:all

# 2. Run all 3 standalone engine examples (see examples/README.md)
npm run examples

# 3. Run independent textbook Python oracle (1,000+ cases), README/blueprint/citation guards & exact-rational audit
python reference/padic_oracle.py
python scripts/check_readme_axioms.py
python scripts/check_citations.py
python scripts/check_blueprint.py
python scripts/verify_exact.py --check-checksums

# 4. Reproduce Exp A-H discovery benchmarks, perf benchmarks & pre-registered Experiment I
npm run discover && npm run bench && npm run stats

# 5. Launch the hardened local WebGL2 + 48 kHz AudioWorklet Observatory (health: GET /healthz)
PORT=4173 node server.mjs
# Open http://127.0.0.1:4173 (or visit https://0thernes.github.io/ultrametrica/)
```

Or run the entire verification, Lean 4, and LaTeX reproduction pipeline with [`justfile`](justfile):

```bash
just reproduce
```

---

## Limitations

See [`LIMITATIONS.md`](LIMITATIONS.md) for the complete scope boundary and literal-vs-metaphor table:

- **No empirical physics claim:** All theorems are strictly mathematical and computational on finite $p$-adic groups $\mathbb{Z}_p / p^n\mathbb{Z}_p$ and finite weighted Bruhat-Tits / Tate-curve graphs.
- **Zero full Mega-Atlas solutions (`0 / 1,900`):** ULTRAMETRICA does not solve the continuum limit or full adelic unification of `SUB-032` ([`docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md`](docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md)).
- **Not peer-reviewed:** Manuscripts are independent preprints; Lean proofs certify logical validity of formalized statements within the stated kernel boundary ([`docs/statement-fidelity.md`](docs/statement-fidelity.md)), while floating-point engine evaluations are explicitly tagged `numerical_approximation`.
- **Finite-$N$ bounds:** `PadicSpace` caps $N = p^n \le 65{,}536$; Theorem V-Global applies to strictly interior vertices of full degree $p + 1$; $n \to \infty$ analytic convergence for $\alpha \ne 1$ is verified up to $N = 625$ rather than proved in Lean.

## FILE: `CLAIMS.md`

# ULTRAMETRICA (`v1.6.0`) — Complete 1-to-1 Claim & Falsification Ledger (`CLAIMS.md`)

> Build Standard `B04` & `B42`, Playbook Section 5 & Gold Standard #14. Author: **Alexander Stephen Donahue** (Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA; ORCID [`0009-0006-8168-9648`](https://orcid.org/0009-0006-8168-9648)).
> Every scientific, mathematical, formal, statistical, and computational claim in ULTRAMETRICA is mapped 1-to-1 below to its exact verification tier, reproducible command, test/proof symbol, verified measurement, and explicit **falsification criterion** (*What Would Prove Us Wrong*).

## Verification Tiers

- **`kernel-checked`:** Machine-verified in pure Lean 4 (`v4.35.0`, Palomar `module`, zero Mathlib, no `sorry` outside the statement-only `Challenge.lean`, zero `native_decide`, `autoImplicit = false`, every file `< 1,000` lines, axioms strictly within `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`) across **148 audited declarations** transparently partitioned into **104 core theorems & corollaries**, **29 zero-Mathlib helper lemmas**, **5 kernel-checked adversarial false-variant refutations** (`AdversarialTests.lean`), and **10 isolated `Spec`/`Challenge`/`Solution` comparator bindings** (standalone re-verifications of the headline targets from pure `Spec.lean`, never double-counted as extra discoveries). All 148 declarations are kernel-checked by Lean (`lake build`, `leanchecker`, and Ubuntu CI `lake check --paranoid`); the **10 comparator targets in `lean/comparator.json` and their dependency closure** are also verified across 6 independent kernels (`lean4`, `leanchecker`, `lean4lean`, `con-leche`, `con-ron`, `nanoda_bin`) via `lake comparator --paranoid` in Ubuntu CI. Seven small `CInt` helper lemmas (`add_smul`, `add_zero_left`, `add_zero_right`, `int_sq_nonneg`, `normSq_nonneg`, `normSq_zero`, `smul_zero`) are transitively checked through the audited theorems invoking them. A Lean statement concerns the repository's own discrete definitions; where a row also carries `exact-rational` or `numerical_approximation`, the row explicitly states which part is kernel-checked.
- **`exact-rational`:** Independently verified with **zero floating-point rounding error** in Python standard library arbitrary-precision `int`, `fractions.Fraction`, and $\mathbb{Q}(i)$ (`scripts/verify_exact.py`).
- **`pre-registered statistical`:** Pre-registered in git-sealed [`docs/preregistration.md`](docs/preregistration.md) (`c171b1b`) prior to execution (sensitivity extensions logged in [`DEVIATIONS.md`](DEVIATIONS.md)), evaluated with 20-seed GUE/GOE controls, 10,000-resample permutation tests, tie-corrected Mann-Whitney $U$, 95% bootstrap CIs for all three effect sizes ($\Delta\langle r\rangle$, Cliff's $\delta$, Cohen's $d$), Holm-Bonferroni correction, and non-pseudoreplicated matrix-level Wilcoxon/sign tests (`scripts/stats_eval.mjs`).
- **`numerical_approximation`:** Verified in IEEE-754 float64 via `test/verify.mjs` (10 theorems), `test/mutants.mjs` (8/8 real source-code mutants killed against unmodified `test/verify.mjs`), `test/properties.mjs` (3,400+ property/metamorphic/curved-BTZ Dijkstra stress cases), `test/fuzz.mjs` (1,000 HTTP/engine fuzz cases), `test/concurrency.mjs` (100 parallel HTTP + EIO storm + AudioWorklet race stress), `test/golden.mjs`, `reference/padic_oracle.py`, and zero-error strict `tsc --noEmit -p jsconfig.json`.
- **`prior work`:** Established literature explicitly credited in [`paper/refs.bib`](paper/refs.bib) (no priority claimed; `18/18` live Crossref DOIs HTTP 200, `0` retractions).

> **Statement audit (2026-11-26, integrated in `v1.6.0`):** An independent statement audit ([audit log](https://github.com/0thernes/0thernes-research-archive/blob/main/docs/reviews/2026-11-26-statement-audit.md)) verified that Lean does not define $D_p^\alpha$, Kozyrev wavelets, $H_\theta$, time evolution, or the $O(V)$ bulk solver, and no Lean theorem sums curvature over the edges of a finite tree. Every row below explicitly separates the kernel-checked lemma from the exact-rational, numerical, or paper-level part; `v1.6.0` also closed the formal Lean gaps identified in that audit (adding kernel-verified primal entry non-negativity to `gen_bridge_primal_sub/sup_optimal`, quantifying `even_prime_self_conjugate`, removing `rt_odd_prime_horizon_dominance`, and strengthening `Challenge.lean`). See [`ERRATA.md`](ERRATA.md).

| **C-ATLAS** | Honest cross-check against all `1,900` problems in `0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas`: **`0 / 1,900` full solutions**; formally verified discrete sub-results on `SUB-032` and negative-result falsification on `ANL-065`/`QM-016`. | Audit / Scope Boundary | Inspect [`docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md`](docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md) | `docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md`, `LIMITATIONS.md` | Exact scan of all `1,900` JSON entries (`635` broad, `46` narrow, `1` primary match `SUB-032`) | **VERIFIED** | Any false claim in our repo asserting a full solution to an open Mega-Atlas problem would contradict this audit. |
| **C-PRIOR** | Foundational $p$-adic analysis, the Monna digit-reversal map (Monna 1970), Vladimirov $D_p^\alpha$, Kozyrev wavelets, $p$-adic AdS/CFT, edge-length gravity, Ollivier-Ricci curvature, Ryu-Takayanagi & Headrick-Takayanagi SSA (2007), Yoshida splitting, and Oganesyan-Huse/Atas spacing ratios belong to cited prior work. | `prior work` | `python scripts/check_citations.py --live` | 21 verified literature references in `paper/refs.bib` | `21/21` BibTeX↔LaTeX, `18/18` live Crossref DOIs HTTP 200, `0` retractions | **CREDITED** | Any uncredited derivation or misattributed prior theorem discovered in our manuscripts. |

## FILE: `LIMITATIONS.md`

# Limitations, Scope Boundaries & Threats to Validity

> Build Standard `B41` & Playbook Section 5 compliance. Every limitation below is stated plainly so reviewers, students, and automated audits can immediately see where ULTRAMETRICA's guarantees stop.

## 1. What ULTRAMETRICA Does NOT Claim

1. **No Empirical Physics Discovery:** ULTRAMETRICA is a mathematical-physics, formal-verification, and computational laboratory. It makes **no claim** of experimental discovery of new physical laws of nature, quantum gravity measurements, or astrophysical black hole observations. Earlier releases described the project as a `"Quantum Gravity Engine"` or `"Holographic Quantum Gravity"`; following the 2026-11-26 statement audit, that wording has been completely withdrawn across `README.md`, `CITATION.cff`, `formalization.yaml`, `package.json`, `AGENTS.md`, `llms.txt`, `src/engine/holography.js`, and `src/web/index.html` in `v1.6.0` because all formal and computational evidence concerns a discrete $p$-adic (Bruhat-Tits tree) holography model only.
2. **Zero Full Solutions to Unsolved Mega-Atlas Problems (`0 / 1,900`):** A full cross-check against all `1,900` open problems in [`0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas`](https://github.com/0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas) confirms that ULTRAMETRICA solves **zero** open problems completely (see [`docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md`](docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md)). It provides exact discrete finite-cutoff sub-results related to `SUB-032` ($p$-adic AdS/CFT) and a negative-result falsification of naive GOE/GUE thermalization in Monna-conjugated adelic hybrids (`ANL-065`/`QM-016`), while leaving continuum limits ($n \to \infty$), full adelic unification over $\mathbb{A}_{\mathbb{Q}}$, and $p$-adic quantum chaos open.
3. **Not Peer-Reviewed:** The accompanying white paper (`dist/Donahue_2026_Ultrametrica.pdf`) and markdown reports are independent research preprints. Machine-checked Lean 4 proofs certify logical validity of the formalized statements within the Lean 4 kernel (with the 10 isolated comparator targets and their dependency closure also checked across 5 additional independent kernels in Ubuntu CI), not mathematical novelty, physical applicability, or external journal endorsement. A formalized statement can be narrower than the prose that cites it; Section 3 lists exact scope boundaries.
4. **No Physical Reality Claim for Metaphorical Labels:** Interactive UI and acoustic terms use physics-inspired terminology that must be distinguished strictly from formal theorems (see Section 2).

---

## 2. Literal Mathematical Objects vs. Metaphorical / Pedagogical Labels

| Term Used in Observatory / Docs | Literal Mathematical Definition in ULTRAMETRICA | What It Is **NOT** |
|---|---|---|
| **$p$-adic AdS/CFT bulk** | Finite cutoff $(p+1)$-regular Bruhat-Tits tree $T_p$ of depth $n$ with discrete Klein-Gordon operator and Gubser mass $m^2(\Delta) = p^\Delta + p^{1-\Delta} - (p+1)$ | Not a UV-complete continuum string theory or full 4D Lorentzian quantum gravity |
| **Rotating Kerr-BTZ black hole** | Discrete Schottky/Tate-curve quotient $T_p / p^{h\mathbb{Z}}$ ($L = p^h \ge 3$) with $U(1)$ Aharonov-Bohm horizon flux $\Omega$ | Not an exact discrete solution of 3+1D vacuum Einstein equations with an ergosphere |
| **Dynamic edge-length gravity** | Damped second-order wave equation on tree edges $\ddot{\sigma}_e + \gamma \dot{\sigma}_e = c^2 \Delta_{\mathrm{line}} \sigma_e - \kappa T_e$ inspired by Gubser et al. (2017) (`numerical_approximation`) | Not a diffeomorphism-invariant canonical quantization of general relativity |
| **Ryu-Takayanagi entropy** | Exact global minimum homologous edge cut $\sum_{e \in \gamma_A} w_e \ln p$ on a finite weighted graph | Not a von Neumann entropy computed from an explicit infinite-dimensional CFT state |
| **Reality Split / Euclidean twin** | Side-by-side comparison of Vladimirov $D_p^\alpha$ evolution against circular Archimedean $(2\pi\min(k,N-k))^\alpha$ evolution on the same grid $\mathbb{Z}/p^n\mathbb{Z}$ | Not a multiverse or physical spacetime splitting claim |
| **Prime-power acoustics (AudioWorklet)** | Sonification mapping Vladimirov shells $p^{\alpha(j+1)}$ and horizon flux to audible sine oscillators ($2^x, 3^x, 5^x, 7^x$) | Not physical acoustic waves in a $p$-adic medium |

---

## 3. Formal-Verification Boundary (What Lean 4 Does vs. Does Not Prove)

- **Inside the Lean 4 Kernel:** All `148` audited declarations across 6 Palomar `module` proof files (`< 1,000` lines each) + `Challenge.lean` / `Solution.lean` — transparently partitioned into **104 core theorems & corollaries**, **29 zero-Mathlib helper lemmas**, **5 adversarial false-variant refutations** (`AdversarialTests.lean`), and **10 isolated comparator target bindings** (never double-counted as extra discoveries) — are kernel-checked by Lean (`lake build`, `leanchecker`, and Ubuntu CI `lake check --paranoid`). The **10 comparator targets in `lean/comparator.json` and their dependency closure** are also verified across 6 independent kernels (`lean4`, `leanchecker`, `lean4lean`, `con-leche`, `con-ron`, `nanoda_bin`) via `lake comparator --paranoid` in Ubuntu CI. The declarations concern the repository's own discrete definitions: universal base-$p$ Monna digit reversal (involution, bijectivity, ball contiguity), subtree-shift prefix preservation, sector-index lemmas ($m \ne p - m$ for odd $p$; quantified $\forall m, 1 \le m < 2 \to m = 2 - m$ at $p = 2$), monotonicity and alternating gaps of the closed-form picket-fence sequence, Kantorovich primal-dual lower bounds and explicit **kernel-verified non-negative** attaining plans for the 3-class BTZ cost model and the arbitrary-degree inhomogeneous bridge-edge cost model (entry non-negativity closed in `v1.6.0`), the definitional split of the curved curvature formula into vertex half-charges, per-vertex half-charge conservation $-(p-1)$, pointwise nonlinearity splitting over $\mathbb{Z}[i]$ for disjoint constant-modulus packets, the integer inequality $1 \le 1 + wq$ under explicit hypotheses $w, q \ge 0$, an abstract arbitrary-dimension $L$ rank-1 Sherman-Morrison identity and edge-level flux parity identities, graph-cut submodularity and strong subadditivity under stated cut-minimality hypotheses, 5 adversarial false-variant refutations, and `8/8` concrete non-vacuity witnesses.
- **Helper lemmas & sanity witnesses:** Seven small `CInt` helper lemmas (`add_smul`, `add_zero_left`, `add_zero_right`, `int_sq_nonneg`, `normSq_nonneg`, `normSq_zero`, `smul_zero`) are not listed separately in `VerifyAxioms.lean` and are transitively checked whenever theorems invoking them are audited. In `v1.6.0`, the trivial 1-liner `rt_odd_prime_horizon_dominance` was removed and `even_prime_self_conjugate` was strengthened from `(1 : Nat) = 2 - 1` to quantified `∀ m, 1 ≤ m → m < 2 → m = 2 - m`; small algebraic corollaries (`btz_critical_L5_p2`, `btz_kappa_from_wasserstein`, `sherman_morrison_denominator_ge_one`) remain explicitly labeled as sanity witnesses / helper bounds.
- **Not defined in Lean:** the Vladimirov operator $D_p^\alpha$, Kozyrev wavelets, the hybrid Hamiltonian $H_\theta$, PDE time evolution, and the $O(V)$ bulk solver. Claims about the spectrum of $H_\theta$, soliton dynamics, positivity of $T$, and solver accuracy rest on exact-rational Python (`verify_exact.py`), numerical (`32` Node tests + `1,000+` Python oracle queries), and pre-registered statistical (`Exp I`) checks.
- **Not formalized in Lean:** (a) the symmetry reduction from couplings on the full BTZ neighbor sets to the 3-class coupling used in Lean (paper-level argument cross-checked across 45 full-graph exact `Fraction` solves); (b) the global tree-level Gauss-Bonnet sum over edges of an explicit finite tree (paper-level assembly of kernel-checked per-edge and per-vertex lemmas, cross-checked across 69 exact `Fraction` plans and 1,000 random JS trees). *(Note: the third `v1.5.0` gap — missing non-negativity in `gen_bridge_primal_sub_optimal` — was **closed in Lean in `v1.6.0`**.)*
- **Known prior results:** Properties of the base-$p$ Monna map (Monna 1970) and discrete graph-cut strong subadditivity (Headrick & Takayanagi, Phys. Rev. D 76, 106013, 2007) are established literature; the Lean files formalize them cleanly for this model with zero priority claimed.
- **Outside the Lean 4 Kernel (`numerical_approximation` — IEEE-754 float64):**
  - IEEE-754 double-precision floating-point Radix-$p$ FFT accuracy, Yoshida $\Delta t^4$ time integration, and Jacobi eigensolver convergence (`test/verify.mjs`, `test/mutants.mjs` 8/8 real source mutants, `test/properties.mjs`, `reference/padic_oracle.py`).
  - Asymptotic $n \to \infty$ analytic proof of $\langle r\rangle_{W_{0,m}} \to r_0(p,m)$ for general $\alpha > 0$ (verified numerically up to $N = 625$ in Experiments E, G, and pre-registered Experiment I — including non-pseudoreplicated 20-matrix sensitivity tests logged in [`DEVIATIONS.md`](DEVIATIONS.md) — not formally proved in the $n \to \infty$ limit).
  - WebGL2 rendering, AudioWorklet DSP audio output, and HTTP network transport (`test/server.mjs`, `test/fuzz.mjs`, `test/concurrency.mjs` + live browser QA).

---

## 4. Computational, Finite-$N$, and Platform Constraints

1. **Finite-Cutoff Tree Boundary Effect:** Theorem V / V-Global holds on strictly interior edges whose endpoints both have full $(p+1)$-regular degree. On a finite cutoff tree of depth $n$, the root has degree $p$ and leaves have degree $1$, so strictly interior perturbations require `n >= 4` and `2 <= depth(u), depth(v) <= n - 2`.
2. **Dimension Cap ($N \le 65{,}536$):** `PadicSpace` caps $N = p^n \le 65{,}536$ to prevent browser/Node OOM and quadratic $O(N^2)$ visual panel stalls. Interactive WebGL2 presets operate comfortably at $N \le 343$.
3. **Real-Time Browser & Audio Requirements:** Live 3D rendering requires WebGL2 (a graceful fallback message is displayed if unavailable); AudioWorklet requires a user gesture and a secure context (`https://` or `localhost`/`127.0.0.1`).
4. **Windows vs. Linux `lake comparator` Sandboxing:** `lake comparator --paranoid` enforces `bubblewrap` (`bwrap`) Linux user-namespace sandboxing on Linux (executed natively in Ubuntu GitHub Actions CI). On Windows hosts, local verification runs `leanchecker --fresh` over `UltrametricaProofs` and `Solution`; full sandboxed 6-kernel comparator assurance comes from the clean Ubuntu CI runner.
5. **Non-Commercial License Constraint:** `COSMOGONIC LICENSE — NON-COMMERCIAL RESEARCH & PLAY` is source-available non-commercial (not OSI-approved open source). Downstream commercial reuse, Mathlib upstreaming, or JOSS submission would require an explicit licensing grant or dual-licensing decision by the author.

## FILE: `REPLICATION.md`

# Independent Replication Protocol & Log

> Build Standard `B43` & `B44`. Every quantitative result, theorem proof, benchmark figure, and PDF in ULTRAMETRICA (`v1.6.0`) can be reproduced end-to-end from a fresh clone with zero paid APIs, zero external runtime npm packages, and zero Mathlib downloads.

## 1. Environment & Resource Requirements

| Component | Minimum Requirement | Tested Reference | Typical Runtime |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Node.js** | `>= 20.x` (tested on `22.x` & `25.x`) | Node `v22` (CI) / `v25.8.2` (Win11) | `~4 s` (all 32 tests incl. real source mutation, B15 fuzz & B19 concurrency), `~7 s` (`discover` + `bench` + `stats`) |
| **Python** | `>= 3.11` (standard library ONLY — zero `pip` packages) | Python `3.13` | `~2 s` (`padic_oracle.py` + `verify_exact.py` + `check_blueprint.py`) |
| **Lean 4** | Exact toolchain pinned in [`lean/lean-toolchain`](lean/lean-toolchain) (`leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0`) | Lean `v4.35.0` (0 Mathlib, Palomar `module`) | `~15 s` clean build + 6-kernel comparator |
| **Tectonic** | `>= 0.15.0` (for optional PDF & vector figure rebuild) | Tectonic `0.17.0` | `~25 s` (5 figures + main PDF + arXiv check) |
| **Hardware** | Any 64-bit x86_64 or arm64 CPU, `>= 2 GB` RAM, `>= 500 MB` free disk | Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX / GitHub Actions runners | Total full stack `< 65 s` |

---

## 2. Clean-Clone Reproduction Steps

```bash
git clone https://github.com/0thernes/ultrametrica.git
cd ultrametrica

# 1. All 32 Node test suites (10 theorems + 8 true source mutants + 3,400+ properties + server/EIO/realpath + golden + 1,000 fuzz + concurrency)
npm run verify:all

# 2. All 3 runnable examples
npm run examples

# 3. Independent Python textbook oracle (1,000+ cases), README axiom guard, live Crossref DOIs, blueprint & exact-rational SHA-256 check
python reference/padic_oracle.py
python scripts/check_readme_axioms.py
python scripts/check_citations.py --live
python scripts/check_blueprint.py
python scripts/verify_exact.py --check-checksums

# 4. Regenerate discovery benchmarks, hardware benchmarks, and pre-registered Experiment I statistics
npm run discover
npm run bench
npm run stats

# 5. Pure Lean 4.35.0 clean build, 148-decl honest 4-bucket axiom audit, leanchecker, and 6-kernel comparator (Linux with bwrap)
cd lean
lake clean
lake build UltrametricaProofs Challenge Solution
lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean
lake env leanchecker --fresh UltrametricaProofs
lake env leanchecker --fresh Solution
lake check --paranoid
lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid
cd ..

# 6. Rebuild vector figures, zero-warning AMS-LaTeX PDF, and verify standalone arXiv tarball
python scripts/generate_figures.py
python scripts/package_dist.py
```

## 3. Expected Tolerances & Exactness Criteria

- **Lean 4 Proofs & 6-Kernel Comparator:** Exact (`0` errors, `0` warnings in `UltrametricaProofs` & `Solution`, **148 audited declarations** = `104 core + 29 helpers + 5 adv + 10 isolated comparator bindings` strictly in `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`, all `10/10` targets pass `lake check --paranoid` and `lake comparator --paranoid`).
- **Python Exact-Rational Falsifier (`verify_exact.py`):** Exact (`0` rounding error — arbitrary-precision `int` & `fractions.Fraction`).
- **Deterministic Golden Snapshot (`test/golden.mjs`):** Exact match to `12` decimal digits (`test/golden/baseline-snapshot.json`).
- **Pre-Registered Experiment I (`scripts/stats_eval.mjs`):** Deterministic seeded PRNG (`seeds 1001..1020`, `10,000` permutation/bootstrap resamples) — `4/4` hypotheses confirmed at primary `p_holm = 0.0004`, Mann-Whitney $U$ `p <= 4.8e-7`, 95% bootstrap CIs for all three effect sizes ($\Delta\langle r\rangle$, Cliff's $\delta$, Cohen's $d$), and non-pseudoreplicated matrix-level sensitivity `p_holm = 7.63e-6` (see [`DEVIATIONS.md`](DEVIATIONS.md)).
- **IEEE-754 Engine & Differential Oracle (`test/verify.mjs`, `test/properties.mjs`, `reference/padic_oracle.py`):** Relative/absolute tolerance `< 1e-11` (actual measured errors `1e-15`–`1.23e-12`).
- **Performance Benchmarks (`scripts/bench.mjs`):** Wall-clock timings depend on host CPU clock and thermal state; verify speedup monotonicity (Radix-$p$ FFT strictly faster than naive DFT at $N \ge 9$, coupled frame step `< 16.67 ms` on modern desktop CPUs) and exact correctness checksums.

## FILE: `VERIFICATION.md`

# Verification, Falsifiability & Authentication Protocol (`v1.6.0`)

**ULTRAMETRICA (`v1.6.0`)** is engineered to be **Provable**, **Falsifiable**, **Verifiable**, and **Authenticated** across eight independent layers: (1) pure Lean 4 (`v4.35.0`, Palomar `module`, `autoImplicit = false`, all 11 `.lean` files `< 1,000` lines) kernel proofs (**148 audited declarations** = `104` core theorems & corollaries + `29` zero-Mathlib helper lemmas + `5` adversarial false-variant refutations across six proof modules + `10` isolated `Spec`/`Challenge`/`Solution` comparator bindings verified via `leanchecker`, `lake check --paranoid`, and 6-kernel `lake comparator --paranoid` inside Linux `bubblewrap` CI), (2) zero-dependency exact-rational Python (`int`, `fractions.Fraction`, $\mathbb{Q}(i)$, and exhaustive brute-force) falsification across Theorems I–VI + independent textbook differential oracle (`reference/padic_oracle.py`), (3) deterministic Node.js `32`-test suite (`10` theorems, **`8/8` true source-code mutants killed** via temp-copy patching of real `src/engine/*.js`, `3,400+` seeded property/metamorphic/curved-BTZ Dijkstra stress/negative tests, **`1,000` deterministic B15 HTTP & engine/audio fuzz cases**, **B19 concurrency + AudioWorklet VM stress**, HTTP contract + `realpath` symlink confinement + disk `EIO` failure injection, golden snapshot) + `3` runnable examples, (4) git-sealed pre-registered confirmatory Experiment I (`docs/preregistration.md`, `c171b1b` -> `4/4` confirmed at primary `p_holm = 0.0004`, Mann-Whitney $U$ `p <= 4.8e-7`, 95% bootstrap CIs for $\Delta\langle r\rangle$, Cliff's $\delta$, and Cohen's $d$, plus non-pseudoreplicated matrix-level sensitivity `p_holm = 7.63e-6`; exploratory deviations logged in `DEVIATIONS.md`) + hardware-tagged performance budgets (`scripts/bench.mjs`), (5) zero-warning AMS-LaTeX PDF (5 vector figures, `21/21` refs) + standalone arXiv bundle + live Crossref DOI/retraction audit (`scripts/check_citations.py --live`), (6) strict static analysis (`tsc --noEmit`, `ruff`, `mypy`: `0` errors), (7) bit-exact cryptographic manifests (`CHECKSUMS.sha256` & `data/MANIFEST.sha256` + SLSA release provenance), and (8) verbatim README `#print axioms` & interactive Proof Blueprint guards (`scripts/check_readme_axioms.py`, `scripts/check_blueprint.py`).

## 1. Independent One-Command Reproduction

```bash
# Layer 1 — All 32 Node tests (10 theorems + 8 true source mutants + properties + server + golden + fuzz + concurrency)
npm run verify:all

# Layer 2 — All 3 runnable examples, independent textbook oracle, README axiom guard, live DOIs, blueprint & SHA-256
npm run examples
python reference/padic_oracle.py
python scripts/check_readme_axioms.py
python scripts/check_citations.py --live
python scripts/check_blueprint.py
python scripts/verify_exact.py --check-checksums
sha256sum -c CHECKSUMS.sha256

# Layer 3 — Reproduce all 9 discovery/statistical/hardware benchmark datasets (Exp A-I & perf)
npm run discover
npm run stats
npm run bench

# Layer 4 — Clean-build pure Lean 4.35.0 library & audit all 148 declarations via VerifyAxioms.lean + leanchecker
cd lean
lake clean && lake build UltrametricaProofs Challenge Solution
lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean
lake env leanchecker --fresh UltrametricaProofs
lake env leanchecker --fresh Solution
# On Linux with bubblewrap (enforced in .github/workflows/ci.yml):
lake check --paranoid
lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid
cd ..

# Layer 5 — Regenerate 5 vector figures, zero-warning AMS-LaTeX PDF, & standalone arXiv tarball
python scripts/generate_figures.py
python scripts/package_dist.py

# Layer 6 — Launch hardened live interactive WebGL2 + 48 kHz AudioWorklet observatory
npm start
# Open http://127.0.0.1:4173 (or visit https://0thernes.github.io/ultrametrica/)
```

| **Exact-Rational Falsifier (`scripts/verify_exact.py`)** | Python 3 stdlib exact arbitrary-precision `int` & `fractions.Fraction` | 7,033 conjugate Adelic pairs ($p \le 19$); 18 picket-fence sectors; 45 exact zero-rounding BTZ optimal-transport horizons; 60 single-edge + 9 simultaneous multi-edge curved AdS Gauss-Bonnet plans; 4,352 exhaustive brute-force RT SSA partitions; exact $\mathbb{Q}(i)$ Rank-1 Sherman-Morrison solve; nested-comment-safe Lean source scan; Experiment I & perf checks; CFF/LICENSE/ORCID/affiliation parity & cryptographic SHA-256 manifests | Finite tested primes, horizons & weights; complements Lean universal proofs |
| **Executable Suite (`test/verify.mjs`, `properties.mjs`, `server.mjs`, `golden.mjs`, `fuzz.mjs`, `concurrency.mjs`)** | Node.js IEEE-754 `Float64` (`node:test`) | **32 tests** covering 10 numerical theorems, 3,400+ seeded property/metamorphic/curved-BTZ Dijkstra stress/negative cases, 1,000 deterministic HTTP & engine/audio fuzz cases (caught real infinite-loop bug `F65`), parallel HTTP + `EIO` + AudioWorklet VM concurrency storm, `realpath` symlink confinement, CSP/header contract, and 12-digit golden snapshot | Finite tested parameter sets ($p \in \{2,3,5,7\}$); not formal universal quantification |
| **True Source-Code Mutants (`test/mutants.mjs`)** | Temp-copied `src/` + unmodified `test/verify.mjs` (`node --test`) | **8/8 real source mutations KILLED** across production lines in `src/engine/{padic,holography,quantum}.js` (M1 Monna reversal, M2 root Robin impedance, M3 BTZ horizon distance, M4 Kerr gauge phase sign, M5 Yoshida `w0` coefficient, M6 BTZ RT horizon skip, M7 asymmetric gravity update, M8 Dijkstra reduced-cost clamping) | Proves `test/verify.mjs` rejects 8 targeted real-code defects; does not exhaust all possible bugs |
| **Discovery & Pre-Registered Benchmarks (`scripts/discover.mjs`, `stats_eval.mjs`, `bench.mjs`)** | Deterministic real & complex Hermitian Jacobi + Johnson Dijkstra + Yoshida + seeded Mulberry32 | **9 reproducible datasets (Exp A–I)** + hardware-tagged perf budgets (`results/discovery-benchmarks.json`, `results/stats-eval.json`, `results/perf-benchmarks.json`) up to $N = 625$ ($\dim W_{0,m} = 125$), $\alpha \in [0.5, 2.0]$, $\Delta \to 0.5001$, and 20-seed GUE/GOE controls | Finite-$N$ empirical measurements; asymptotic $n \to \infty$ operator-norm bound remains open |
| **Manuscript & Live Observatory** | Tectonic `0.17.0` + WebGL2 + WebAudio | Zero-warning AMS-LaTeX PDF (5 vector figures, `21/21` refs, [`dist/Donahue_2026_Ultrametrica.pdf`](dist/Donahue_2026_Ultrametrica.pdf)) + standalone arXiv bundle ([`dist/arxiv_submission.tar.gz`](dist/arxiv_submission.tar.gz)) + live GitHub Pages observatory & Proof Blueprint | Presentation & visualization layers |

## 3. Falsification Protocol (How to Break Any Claim)

We explicitly invite counterexamples and prior-literature challenges via our [Falsification Issue Template](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/falsification.yml). Any single item below falsifies the corresponding claim:

1. **To falsify Theorem I / $\alpha$-Invariant Modular Picket-Fence Law:** Produce any prime $p$, depth $n$, exponent $\alpha > 0$, or $\theta \in (0, 1)$ where (a) the Fourier-basis Monna-conjugated Vladimirov matrix has any cross-sector entry $|M_{jk}| > 10^{-11}$ between distinct $(v_p(k), (k/p^v)\bmod p)$ sectors, OR (b) an odd prime $p \ge 3$ produces $> (p^n + 1)/2$ distinct eigenvalues of $H_\theta$.
2. **To falsify Theorem II (Unified BTZ Ollivier-Ricci Law & $L_c = 5$ Trichotomy):** Produce any $p \ge 2, L \ge 3$ uniform Tate-curve BTZ graph where exact non-lazy 1-Wasserstein optimal transport differs from $\kappa_{\text{BTZ}}(p, L) = -(2p - \max(0, 6-L))/(p+2)$.
3. **To falsify Theorem III (Arbitrary $K$-Ball Kozyrev Compacton-Solitons):** Produce any local nonlinearity $F(|\psi|^2)$ and pairwise-disjoint Kozyrev wavelet superposition that radiates $> 10^{-11}$ probability outside its initial support under $D_p^\alpha + F(|\psi|^2)$.
4. **To falsify Theorem IV (Kerr-BTZ Bulk Solver & Parity):** Produce any curved positive edge weights $w_e > 0$ and horizon flux $\Omega \in [-\pi, \pi]$ (with $\Delta \ge 0.5001$) where the $O(V)$ Schur + Sherman-Morrison solver divides by zero or produces an uneliminated Klein-Gordon residual $> 10^{-11}$.
5. **To falsify Theorems V & V-Global (Curved AdS Discrete Gauss-Bonnet Conservation & Supercritical Pinch Deficit):** Produce any prime $p \ge 2$ and finite interior edge weights $w_e > 0$ on $T_p$ whose total curvature excess $\sum_{e'}(\kappa_{e'} - \kappa_{\mathrm{AdS}})$ differs from $-2 \sum_{e'} \max(0, w_{e'}/W_u + w_{e'}/W_v - 1)$.
6. **To falsify Theorem VI (Universal Discrete Holographic RT Strong Subadditivity):** Produce any finite non-negatively weighted graph and pairwise-disjoint boundary regions $(A, B, C)$ where $S(A \cup B \cup C) + S(B) > S(A \cup B) + S(B \cup C)$.
7. **To challenge formal soundness:** Detect `sorryAx`, `native_decide`, or any axiom outside `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` in `cd lean && lake clean && lake build UltrametricaProofs Challenge Solution && lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean && lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid`.

## 4. Authenticated Cryptographic Manifests (`CHECKSUMS.sha256` & `data/MANIFEST.sha256`)

All tracked source, proof, benchmark, audit, manuscript, figure, and distribution files are cryptographically hashed in the root manifest [`CHECKSUMS.sha256`](CHECKSUMS.sha256) and [`data/MANIFEST.sha256`](data/MANIFEST.sha256), and automatically verified on every push in GitHub Actions CI (`sha256sum -c CHECKSUMS.sha256` and `python scripts/verify_exact.py --check-checksums`), alongside SLSA build-provenance attestations on every tagged GitHub Release.

## FILE: `docs/architecture.md`

# System Architecture (`docs/architecture.md`)

> Build Standard `A20`. ULTRAMETRICA (`v1.6.0`) is engineered as a **zero-dependency**, cleanly layered mathematical-physics engine, real-time WebGL2/AudioWorklet observatory, interactive Lean 4 Proof Blueprint, and pure Lean 4 (`v4.35.0`, Palomar `module`) formal verification stack.

## 1. High-Level Layered Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    subgraph UI["Interactive Observatory & Proof Blueprint (src/web/, WCAG 2.2 AA)"]
        HTML["index.html + styles.css + blueprint.html"]
        APP["app.js + blueprint.js (State, URL Permalinks, Keyboard, DAG)"]
        GL["renderer3d.js (WebGL2 GLSL 300 es, 60 FPS)"]
        P2D["panels2d.js (Twin Oscilloscope, Ultrametric Triangles, Wavelets)"]
        AUD["audio.js + audio-worklet.js (48 kHz Lock-Free O(1) Foldback DSP)"]
    end

    subgraph ENGINE["Zero-Dependency Strict-JSDoc Engine (src/engine/)"]
        SIM["simulation.js (6 Presets, Coupled Loop, Telemetry)"]
        PAD["padic.js (Radix-p FFT, Vladimirov D_p^alpha, Monna R_p, Kozyrev)"]
        QTM["quantum.js (4th-Order Yoshida Symplectic PDE + Euclidean R Twin)"]
        HOL["holography.js (O(V) Schur + Rank-1 Kerr-BTZ, Dijkstra Ricci, Tree/Cycle DP RT)"]
    end

    subgraph SERVER["Hardened Local Host (server.mjs)"]
        HTTP["Node HTTP Server (/healthz, CSP, realpath Sandbox, Structured JSON Logs)"]
    end

    subgraph VERIFY["Multi-Layer Independent Verification Stack"]
        NODE["test/{verify,mutants,properties,server,golden,fuzz,concurrency}.mjs (32 Tests)"]
        PY["reference/padic_oracle.py + scripts/verify_exact.py (Exact Fraction & Q(i))"]
        STATS["scripts/{discover,bench,stats_eval}.mjs (Exp A-I + Perf)"]
        LEAN["lean/ (148 Audited Lean 4.35.0 Decls across 6 Proof Modules + 6-Kernel Comparator)"]
        PAPER["paper/main.tex + scripts/{generate_figures,package_dist}.py (Zero-Warn PDF)"]
    end

    HTML --> APP
    APP --> SIM
    SIM --> PAD
    SIM --> QTM
    SIM --> HOL
    QTM --> PAD
    HOL --> PAD
    SIM --> GL
    SIM --> P2D
    SIM --> AUD
    HTTP -.->|serves static ES modules| UI
    NODE --> ENGINE
    NODE --> SERVER
    PY --> ENGINE
    STATS --> ENGINE
    LEAN -.->|formal theorems Thm I-VI| ENGINE
    STATS --> PAPER
    LEAN --> PAPER
```

## 2. Module Responsibilities & Data Flow

### Layer 1 — Pure Mathematical Engine (`src/engine/`, Strict `tsc --noEmit` Zero-Error JSDoc)
- **`padic.js` (`PadicSpace`):** Encodes the finite $p$-adic boundary $\mathbb{Z}_p / p^n \mathbb{Z}_p$ ($N = p^n \le 65{,}536$, prime $p \ge 2$, $n \ge 2$). Provides exact little-endian digit extraction, universal base-$p$ Monna digit-reversal involution $R_p$ (`revTable`), ultrametric norm $|x - y|_p$, native $O(p N \log_p N)$ unitary Radix-$p$ Pontryagin FFT (`fftForward`/`fftInverse`), Vladimirov spectrum $|\xi_k|_p^\alpha$, RMS-calibrated Euclidean twin spectrum, and orthonormal Kozyrev wavelets $\psi_{j,b,m}$.
- **`quantum.js` (`PadicQuantumEngine`):** Evolves the nonlinear $p$-adic Gross-Pitaevskii equation $i \partial_t \psi = (D_p^\alpha + g|\psi|^2 + V_{\mathrm{grav}})\psi$ alongside a synchronized Archimedean $\mathbb{R}$ twin using 4th-order Yoshida symplectic operator splitting (3 symmetric Drift-Kick-Drift substeps).
- **`holography.js` (`BruhatTitsBulk`):** Constructs the $(p+1)$-regular cutoff Bruhat-Tits tree $T_p$ (`horizonDepth = 0`) or genus-1 Tate-curve rotating Kerr-BTZ black hole quotient $T_p / p^{h\mathbb{Z}}$ (`horizonDepth >= 1`, $L = p^h \ge 3$, Aharonov-Bohm flux $\Omega \in [-\pi,\pi]$). Solves the gauge-covariant bulk Klein-Gordon equation in exact $O(V)$ time via bottom-up subtree Schur complements + Rank-1 Sherman-Morrison wrap-edge update (Theorem IV), updates dynamic edge lengths $\sigma_e = \ln a_e$ via symmetric Jacobi updates (`_sigmaSnap`), computes exact bipartite **Johnson potential-reduced Dijkstra** (`rc >= 0`, negative-cycle impossible) 1-Wasserstein Ollivier-Ricci curvature (Theorems II, V, V-Global), and solves global minimum homologous Ryu-Takayanagi cuts in exact $O(V)$ tree/cycle DP (Theorem VI).
- **`simulation.js` (`UltrametricaSimulation`):** Coordinates 6 curated scientific presets (`kozyrev_trap`, `btz_black_hole`, `ultrametric_tunneling`, `adelic_fracture`, `page_transition`, `wormhole_surgery`), coupled boundary-bulk feedback, telemetry metrics (ball leakage, norm drift, entropy, curvature extrema, Kerr horizon current), and Adelic hybrid spectrum sweeps.

### Layer 2 — Real-Time Interactive Observatory, Blueprint (`src/web/`) & Host (`server.mjs`)
- **`renderer3d.js`:** Zero-dependency WebGL2 GLSL 300 es renderer with cached uniform locations, shader link cleanup, `pointercancel` safety, ray-picking, `webglcontextlost`/`webglcontextrestored` recovery, and reduced-motion awareness.
- **`panels2d.js`:** Canvas 2D twin oscilloscope, live ultrametric isosceles triangle prover, and Pontryagin shell spectrum.
- **`audio.js` + `audio-worklet.js`:** Lock-free 48 kHz AudioWorklet synthesizing Vladimirov prime-power shells with $O(1)$ log-space frequency folding (`F65`), exponential click-free smoothing, and finite-value guards.
- **`blueprint.html` + `blueprint.css` + `blueprint.js`:** Strict-CSP interactive Lean 4 Proof Blueprint & Dependency DAG (`54/54` key declarations + `10/10` targets checked by `scripts/check_blueprint.py`).
- **`server.mjs`:** Hardened local static server enforcing strict `src/` + `fsImpl.realpath` symlink confinement, `GET`/`HEAD` allowlist, protocol-relative & control-char URL filters, strict CSP (`default-src 'self'`), fail-fast `PORT` validation (`parsePort`), single-source `VERSION`, `/healthz` JSON probe, and structured JSON logging (`LOG_FORMAT=json`).

### Layer 3 — Formal Proofs (`lean/`) & Independent Oracles (`reference/`, `scripts/`)
- **`lean/`:** Zero-Mathlib Lean 4 (`v4.35.0`, Palomar `module`, all 11 files `< 1,000` lines) split cleanly into statement-only definitions (`UltrametricaProofs/Spec.lean`), six sorry-free proof modules (`Basic`, `AdelicSymmetry`, `HolographyCurvature`, `MultiEdgeHolography`, `SolitonAndSolver`, `AdversarialTests`), `VerifyAxioms.lean` (`148` audited declarations = `104 core + 29 helpers + 5 adv + 10 isolated comparator bindings`), and isolated `Challenge.lean` / `Solution.lean` / `comparator.json` (`10` targets) audited via `lake check --paranoid` and 6-kernel `lake comparator --paranoid`.
- **`reference/padic_oracle.py` & `scripts/verify_exact.py`:** Completely decoupled Python stdlib implementations verifying exact rational `fractions.Fraction` optimal transport, exact $\mathbb{Q}(i)$ linear solves, exact brute-force RT SSA, nested-comment-safe Lean audits, and SHA-256 manifests.

## FILE: `docs/statement-fidelity.md`

# Lean 4 Statement-Fidelity & Non-Vacuity Audit (`docs/statement-fidelity.md`)

> Independent AI Research Playbook (`v1.3`) Section 1, Gold Standard #8 & #12, and Palomar Registry compliance. Every formal theorem in `lean/Challenge.lean` and `lean/UltrametricaProofs/` (`v1.6.0`, `148` audited declarations across 6 Palomar `module` proof files, every file `< 1,000` lines) is audited line-by-line against its literal mathematical statement, checked for hidden vacuous hypotheses, paired with explicit concrete non-vacuity witnesses across **all 8** theorem targets, and sharpened by 5 kernel-checked adversarial false-variant negations. Verdicts below incorporate the independent `2026-11-26` statement audit ([`../ERRATA.md`](../ERRATA.md)), marking where Lean proves a narrower algebraic/reduced-model lemma vs. where `v1.6.0` directly closed formal gaps (primal entry non-negativity in Target 7, quantified $p = 2$ self-conjugacy in Target 1, full $L$-dim Sherman-Morrison in Target 5, tight BTZ primal attainment in Target 3, and 8/8 non-vacuity witnesses in Target 10).

## 1. Zero-Trust Architecture & Honest 4-Bucket Accounting

- **Honest Non-Inflated Declaration Breakdown (`148` Audited Total):**
  1. **Core Mathematical Theorems & Corollaries:** `104` declarations
  2. **Zero-Mathlib Algebraic / Arithmetic Helper Lemmas:** `29` declarations (`RatQ.*`, `finSum_*`, `sumInt_map_mul`, `ratq_sumList_same_den`, `geomSum_pos`, `revBase*` recursion helpers, `pow_dvd_add*`, `odd_pow_is_odd`, `hermitianDot_*`, `picket_fence_{even,odd}_val`)
  3. **Adversarial False-Variant Refutations (`AdversarialTests.lean`):** `5` explicit negations (`¬ (...)`)
  4. **Isolated Palomar Comparator Target Bindings (`Solution.lean` ↔ `Challenge.lean`):** `10` standalone targets — **explicitly documented as zero-trust isolated re-verifications of the headline targets from pure `Spec.lean`, NEVER double-counted as separate mathematical discoveries.**
  *(Seven small `CInt` helper lemmas — `add_smul`, `add_zero_left`, `add_zero_right`, `int_sq_nonneg`, `normSq_nonneg`, `normSq_zero`, `smul_zero` — are transitively checked whenever theorems using them are audited.)*
- **Palomar `module` System & File Size Discipline:** Every `.lean` file in `lean/` begins with `module` (`public import` / `public theorem` / `@[expose] public def`), uses `autoImplicit = false` and `relaxedAutoImplicit = false`, and stays strictly under `1,000` lines (`HolographyCurvature.lean`: `860` lines; `MultiEdgeHolography.lean`: `953` lines; Playbook Finding 16).
- **[`lean/UltrametricaProofs/Spec.lean`](../lean/UltrametricaProofs/Spec.lean):** Contains *only* pure mathematical definitions (`136` lines, zero theorems, zero tactics, zero `sorry`), including `revBase`, `picketVal`, `btzTransportCost`, `finSum`, `genBridgeTransportCost`, `rtCutCap`, `CInt`, `CVec`, and `hermitianDot`.
- **[`lean/Challenge.lean`](../lean/Challenge.lean):** `214` lines, imports *only* `UltrametricaProofs.Spec` and states all **10 upgraded canonical verification targets** with intentional `sorry` placeholders (importing **none** of the 6 proof modules).
- **[`lean/Solution.lean`](../lean/Solution.lean):** `630` lines, proves all **10 targets** in `Ultrametrica.ComparatorTarget` with **zero `sorry`**, **zero `admit`**, **zero `native_decide`**, and **zero custom axioms**.

## 2. Line-by-Line Theorem Statement Fidelity Matrix (10 Upgraded Targets)

| Target / Theorem | Paper / Literature Statement | Exact Lean 4 Statement (`Challenge.lean` / Proof Module) | Fidelity Verdict & Exact Scope Boundary | Non-Vacuity / Sharpness Witness |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Target 1 — Theorem I (Monna, Ball Contiguity & Parity)** | For all $p \ge 2, n \in \mathbb{N}, j \le n, x, y < p^n$: $R_p(R_p(x)) = x$, $R_p(p^n - 1 - x) = p^n - 1 - R_p(x)$, ball contiguity $x \equiv y \pmod{p^j} \iff \lfloor R_p(x)/p^{n-j} \rfloor = \lfloor R_p(y)/p^{n-j} \rfloor$, odd primes separate $m \ne p - m$, and for $p = 2$, every $1 \le m < 2$ satisfies $m = 2 - m$. | `target_thm1_monna_and_parity` (upgraded `v1.6.0`: includes `padic_ball_monna_contiguity` and quantified `∀ m, 1 ≤ m → m < 2 → m = 2 - m`, replacing literal `1 = 2 - 1`) + `Basic.lean` + `AdelicSymmetry.lean` | **EXACT MATCH for Monna & ball contiguity (formalizing Monna 1970); index lemmas only for parity.** $H_\theta$, $D_p^\alpha$, and sectors $W_{s,m}$ are not defined in Lean; block diagonalization and odd/even doublet counts are exact-rational and numerical checks (`verify_exact.py`, `test/verify.mjs`). | Target 10 #1 (`Spec.revBase 3 4 5 = 63 ∧ 5 < 3^4`) + `adv_dyadic_breaks_odd_doublet_protection`. |
| **Target 2 — Prop. 4.2 (Modular Picket-Fence Law)** | For all $p \ge 2, 1 \le m, 2m \le p, a \in \mathbb{N}$: folded frequencies $u_{2a} = ap + m, u_{2a+1} = (a+1)p - m$ interleave monotonically with exact gaps $p - 2m$ and $2m$. | `target_thm1_picket_fence_law` + `AdelicSymmetry.lean` (`picket_fence_monotone`, `picket_fence_even_gap`, `picket_fence_odd_gap`, `picket_fence_gap_sum`) | **EXACT MATCH (closed-form frequency sequence only).** Theorems concern `picketVal`/`picketSeq`, not eigenvalues of an operator; identification with folded eigenfrequencies and asymptotic $\alpha$-invariance as $n \to \infty$ are verified numerically & statistically (Exp E/G/I), not formalized in Lean. | Target 10 #2 (`Spec.picketVal 5 1 1 - Spec.picketVal 5 1 0 = 3`). |
| **Target 3 — Theorem II (Tight Primal-Dual BTZ Ollivier-Ricci & $L_c = 5$)** | For all $p \ge 2, L \ge 3$: exact non-lazy 1-Wasserstein optimal transport on the reduced 3-class BTZ horizon model satisfies BOTH the universal dual lower bound over all non-negative couplings AND existence of a feasible non-negative primal coupling attaining exact equality, giving $\kappa_{\mathrm{BTZ}} = -(2p - \max(0, 6-L))/(p+2)$. | `target_thm2_btz_ollivier_ricci` (upgraded `v1.6.0`: includes BOTH Kantorovich dual lower bound AND existential feasible non-negative primal attainment) + `HolographyCurvature.lean` | **EXACT MATCH for the 3-class reduced model (cleared denominator).** Class distances (`opp`, `back`, `child`; masses $M, M, pM$) are checked against cycle-distance offsets (`btz_graph_metric_eq_classDist`), while the symmetry reduction from full neighbor-set couplings to 3-class couplings is a paper-level argument cross-checked on the full graph via 45 exact `Fraction` solves. | Target 10 #3 (`(p=3, L=5)` excess `0`, `btzGraphDist 5 .back .back = 2`) + 45 exact `Fraction` solves + `adv_btz_L5_not_universally_flatter`. |
| **Target 4 — Theorem III (Arbitrary $K$-Packet Disjoint Nonlinearity Splitting)** | For ANY finite list of $K$ pairwise-disjoint constant-modulus packets and ANY local nonlinearity $F$: $F(\|\sum \psi_r\|^2)(\sum \psi_r) = \sum F(c_r)\psi_r$ pointwise with zero inter-ball cross-talk. | `target_thm3_multiball_soliton` + `SolitonAndSolver.lean` (`multi_ball_kozyrev_soliton_list`) | **PARTIAL (pointwise nonlinearity-splitting lemma over $\mathbb{Z}[i]$).** Lean does not define $D_p^\alpha$, Kozyrev wavelets, or PDE time evolution; `kozyrev_exact_nonlinear_soliton` takes an abstract operator $D$ with an assumed eigenfunction property. Soliton dynamics are paper arguments checked numerically (Exp C & F). | Target 10 #4 (concrete 2-mode disjoint list witness) + Exp C + `adv_overlapping_modes_violate_zero_crosstalk`. |
| **Target 5 — Theorem IV (Kerr-BTZ Rank-1 Algebraic Core, Full Arbitrary-$L$ Sherman-Morrison & Parity)** | Integer inequality $1 \le 1 + wq$ for $w, q \ge 0$, abstract arbitrary-dimension $L$ complex Hermitian Sherman-Morrison exact identity $(T + w u u^\dagger)(\mathrm{den}\,y - (w u^\dagger y)z) = \mathrm{den}\,b$ (for linear $T$ with assumed $Ty = b, Tz = u$), and edge-level flux parity $E(-\Omega)=E(\Omega)$, $J(-\Omega)=-J(\Omega)$. | `target_thm4_kerr_solver_and_parity` (upgraded `v1.6.0`: full arbitrary-dimension $L$ complex Hermitian Sherman-Morrison identity directly inside `Challenge.lean`) + `SolitonAndSolver.lean` | **PARTIAL (abstract algebraic core only).** Positivity $q = u^\dagger T^{-1} u \ge 0$ enters as explicit hypothesis $0 \le q$ (holding when $T \succ 0$ above the BF bound; `"unconditional"` withdrawn). The $O(V)$ Schur solver, positivity of $T$, and BF stability ($\Delta = 0.5001$) are not in Lean (verified via exact $\mathbb{Q}(i)$ solve & Exp D/H). | Target 10 #5 (`L=1` concrete denominator `⟨3, 0⟩`) + exact $\mathbb{Q}(i)$ solve (`verify_exact.py`, residual $= 0$). |
| **Target 6 — Theorem V-Global (Per-Edge & Per-Vertex Curved Gauss-Bonnet Identities)** | On arbitrary weighted interior bridge edges, exact conductance curvature splits into vertex half-charges $-(p-1)w_e/W_u$ minus the supercritical deficit when $w_e/W_u + w_e/W_v > 1$, and per-vertex half-charges sum to $-(p-1)$ for every positive-sum weight list. | `target_thm5_global_curved_gauss_bonnet` + `MultiEdgeHolography.lean` (`curved_gen_kappa_charge_decomp`, `global_multi_edge_vertex_charge_conservation`) | **PARTIAL (per-edge and per-vertex lemmas only).** `global_multi_edge_vertex_charge_conservation` sums per-vertex half-charge expressions over arbitrary lists of positive-sum integer weight lists; no Lean theorem sums curvature over the edges of an explicit finite tree. The global zero-excess / deficit sum is a paper-level assembly cross-checked over 69 exact `Fraction` plans and 1,000 random JS trees. Finite-cutoff caveat: interior vertices of full degree $p+1$. | Target 10 #6 (`curvedGenDeficitNum 2 5 7 = 0`, `8 10 10 = 120`) + `adv_supercritical_pinch_breaks_conservation`. |
| **Target 7 — Theorem V-Global Tight Primal-Dual Multi-Edge Bridge Kantorovich Duality** | For ALL $p \in \mathbb{N}$ and ALL arbitrary inhomogeneous positive incident conductances $(w, u_1 \dots u_p, v_1 \dots v_p)$ with lengths $w a_e = u_r a_r = v_s a'_s = D$: BOTH universal dual lower bounds across all non-negative couplings AND existence of explicit **kernel-verified non-negative** feasible primal couplings attaining exact equality in BOTH subcritical and supercritical regimes. | `target_thm5_kantorovich_dual` (upgraded `v1.6.0`: includes subcritical/supercritical hypotheses, dual lower bounds, AND existential **non-negative** primal attainment `0 ≤ M, P00, P0y s, Px0 r, Pxy r s` in BOTH regimes — directly closing `F48`/`F49` & the 2026-11-26 audit finding!) + `MultiEdgeHolography.lean` | **EXACT MATCH for the reduced bridge-edge cost model (`genBridgeTransportCost`).** `genBridgeTransportCost` is a reduced cost model written in `Spec.lean` (not derived from a general graph); primal entry non-negativity is now 100% kernel-checked in BOTH subcritical and supercritical regimes (`v1.6.0`). | Target 10 #7 (`p=2` concrete inhomogeneous bridge `w=2, uW=[1,2], vW=[3,1], D=12`) + 69 exact `Fraction` plans + 1,000 JS trees. |
| **Target 8 — Theorem VI (Graph-Cut Strong Subadditivity)** | On ANY finite non-negative `Nat`-weighted graph, for disjoint boundary regions $A, C$ and arbitrary homologous cuts $W_{AB}, W_{BC}$, $S(A \cup B \cup C) + S(B) \le \mathrm{cap}(W_{AB}) + \mathrm{cap}(W_{BC})$ whenever $S(A \cup B \cup C)$ and $S(B)$ lower-bound homologous cut capacities. | `target_thm6_holographic_ssa` + `MultiEdgeHolography.lean` (`rt_edge_cut_submodular`, `rt_cut_submodular`, `rt_strong_subadditivity`, `rt_subadditivity`) | **EXACT MATCH (discrete cut-capacity form of Headrick & Takayanagi 2007).** Holds for arbitrary finite `Nat`-weighted edge lists and `Bool` vertex sets under the stated cut-minimality hypotheses; established prior result, no priority claimed. | Target 10 #8 (`rtCutCap = 5, 8`) + `adv_rt_ssa_reverse_inequality_false` (strict gap `21 > 13`). |
| **Target 9 — Adversarial False-Variant Refutations** | Explicit kernel-checked negations `¬ (...)` proving $p = 2$ breaks odd-prime disjointness, supercritical pinch breaks Gauss-Bonnet conservation, and RT SSA is a strict inequality (reverse inequality is false). | `target_adversarial_refutations` + `AdversarialTests.lean` (5 explicit negations across Theorems I, II, III, V/V-Global, VI) | **EXACT MATCH (Playbook Gold Standard #12).** Proves hypotheses are mathematically sharp and prevents degenerate/vacuous formalization. | Proved directly by kernel reduction & contradiction (`0` custom axioms). |

## FILE: `docs/preregistration.md`

# Pre-Registration of Statistical & Multi-Edge Hypotheses (`v1.4.0`)

**Author:** Alexander Stephen Donahue (Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA · ORCID [`0009-0006-8168-9648`](https://orcid.org/0009-0006-8168-9648))  
**Date:** 2026-11-25  
**Status:** Sealed prior to running `scripts/stats_eval.py` (Experiment I)  
**Scope:** Strictly distinguishes *exploratory* benchmarks archived in `v1.0.0`–`v1.3.0` (`Experiments A–H`) from *pre-registered confirmatory* tests introduced in `v1.4.0` (`Experiment I`).

---

## 1. Honest Disclosure: Exploratory vs. Pre-Registered Work

- **Exploratory (`Experiments A–H`, `v1.0.0`–`v1.3.0`):** Deterministic mathematical/numerical sweeps over `p in {2,3,5,7}` that motivated Theorems I–V and Proposition 4.2. Because these sweeps preceded formal preregistration, they are explicitly labeled **exploratory** (and mathematically certified independently via pure Lean 4 proofs and exact `fractions.Fraction` arithmetic where applicable).
- **Pre-Registered Confirmatory (`Experiment I`, `v1.4.0`):** Specified below **before** executing `scripts/stats_eval.py` and recording `results/stats-eval.json`.

---

## 2. Pre-Registered Hypotheses (`Experiment I`)

### Family A — Statistical Rejection of Random-Matrix GUE/GOE Thermalization in $H_\theta$ (`B28`–`B31`)

- **Treatment Arm:** Intra-sector adjacent level spacing ratios $r_j = \min(\delta_j, \delta_{j+1}) / \max(\delta_j, \delta_{j+1})$ inside the top-level valuation-residue sectors $W_{0,m}$ of $H_{\theta=0.5}$ at $\alpha \in \{1.0, 2.0\}$ for:
  - **H1:** $(p, n, m) = (5, 4, 2)$ ($\dim W_{0,2} = 125$, predicted picket-fence $r_0 = 1/4 = 0.25$) vs. matched-dimension $125 \times 125$ GUE random Hermitian control matrices.
  - **H2:** $(p, n, m) = (5, 4, 1)$ ($\dim W_{0,1} = 125$, predicted picket-fence $r_0 = 2/3 \approx 0.6667$) vs. matched-dimension $125 \times 125$ GOE random real symmetric control matrices.
  - **H3:** $(p, n, m) = (2, 7, 1)$ ($\dim W_{0,1} = 64$, predicted picket-fence $r_0 = 0$) vs. matched-dimension $64 \times 64$ GOE random real symmetric control matrices.
  - **H4 (Quadratic Dispersion $\alpha = 2.0$):** $(p, n, m) = (5, 4, 2)$ at $\alpha = 2.0$ vs. matched-dimension $125 \times 125$ GUE control matrices.
- **Control Arm & Fixed Seeds (`B28`):** $K = 20$ independent fixed-seed random Hermitian GUE / real symmetric GOE control matrices (`seeds = [1001..1020]`) generated by a deterministic Box-Muller seeded PRNG (`mulberry32`), diagonalized by the exact same Jacobi solver as the treatment arm.
- **Primary Metric:** Difference in sample mean spacing ratio $\Delta \langle r \rangle = \langle r \rangle_{\text{Adelic}} - \langle r \rangle_{\text{RMT}}$ per seed ($N_{\text{seeds}} = 20$ paired/per-seed contrasts against the deterministic treatment spectrum, plus two-sample Mann-Whitney U & 10,000-resample Monte Carlo permutation test on the full vector of individual spacing ratios $\{r_j\}$).
- **Statistical Test (`B29`):** Two-sided Monte Carlo permutation test (`10,000` seeded permutations, `seed = 20261125`) comparing the empirical treatment spacing ratios $\{r_j\}$ against the pooled 20-seed RMT control spacing ratios, plus exact sign/Wilcoxon check over the 20 per-seed control means.
- **Effect Size & 95% CI (`B30`):** Difference of means $\Delta \langle r \rangle$, Cliff's $\delta$, and Cohen's $d$, each paired with a seeded `10,000`-resample percentile bootstrap 95% confidence interval (`seed = 20261125`).
- **Multiple-Comparison Correction (`B31`):** Holm-Bonferroni step-down family-wise error rate adjustment across all 4 hypotheses (`alpha_FWER = 0.01`).
- **Decision / Falsification Rule:** A hypothesis is **confirmed** if and only if its Holm-Bonferroni adjusted $p_{\text{adj}} < 0.01$ AND the 95% bootstrap CI for $\Delta \langle r \rangle$ excludes $0$ in the predicted direction ($< 0$ for H1, H3, H4; $> 0$ for H2). Otherwise, the hypothesis is **refuted** and reported as a negative result.
- **Stopping Rule:** Fixed exact design (`K = 20` seeds, `10,000` permutations, `10,000` bootstrap resamples); zero sequential peeking or seed dropping.

---

## 3. Deviations Log (Append-Only)

| Date | Deviation | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-25 | None (pre-execution seal). | Initial preregistration committed before running `scripts/stats_eval.py`. |
| 2026-11-26 | `DEV-01`, `DEV-02`, `DEV-03` (logged in full in [`DEVIATIONS.md`](../DEVIATIONS.md)). | (1) Implemented runner as zero-dependency `scripts/stats_eval.mjs` directly importing `src/engine/*.js`; (2) Added promised Mann-Whitney $U$ and 10,000-resample 95% bootstrap CIs for Cliff's $\delta$ & Cohen's $d$ (preserving the exact primary RNG stream `20261125` bit-for-bit); (3) Added non-pseudoreplicated matrix-level sensitivity tests (exact sign test, exact Wilcoxon signed-rank, empirical rank $1/21$, matrix $z$-score). |
