## FILE: `docs/benchmarks.md`

# Performance Benchmarks & Latency Budgets (`docs/benchmarks.md`)

> Build Standard `A37`, `B26`, and `B27`. Every number below is reproduced directly by `npm run bench` (`scripts/bench.mjs`), archived in [`results/perf-benchmarks.json`](../results/perf-benchmarks.json), and paired with a live correctness checksum so timing can never pass on broken math.

## 1. Hardware & Runtime Provenance

- **CPU:** Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX (24 logical cores)
- **OS / Architecture:** `win32-x64`
- **Runtime:** Node.js `v25.8.2` (zero external dependencies)
- **Methodology:** Warm-up iterations discarded before timing; `10–15` timed outer runs per kernel reporting **median**, **IQR** (interquartile range), **min**, **max**, and an algebraic/numerical **correctness checksum**.

---

## 2. Explicit Performance Budgets (`v1.6.0`)

| Kernel / Operation | Hard Budget | Measured Median (`v1.6.0`) | IQR | Margin | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Coupled BTZ Frame Step (`p=3, n=5, L=9`, Yoshida + Bulk KG + Dijkstra Ricci + Gravity) | `< 16.67 ms` (60 FPS) | **`0.7485 ms`** | `0.4404 ms` | **22.3× faster than budget** | PASS |
| Full Bulk KG + Dijkstra Ricci + Exact RT (`p=5, n=4, N=625`, BTZ $L=5$) | `< 10.00 ms` | **`0.1236 ms`** | `0.0369 ms` | **80.9× faster than budget** | PASS |
| Native Radix-$p$ Pontryagin FFT (`p=5, n=4, N=625`, single transform) | `< 1.00 ms` | **`0.0287 ms`** (`0.2867 ms / 10`) | `0.0022 ms` | **34.9× faster than budget** | PASS |

---

## 3. Algorithmic Speedup: Native Radix-$p$ FFT vs. Textbook $O(N^2)$ DFT

| Dimension $(p, n, N)$ | Radix-$p$ FFT (per call) | Naive $O(N^2)$ DFT (per call) | Speedup | Max Error Checksum |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `p=3, n=2, N=9` | `0.000260 ms` (`0.0520 ms / 200`) | `0.001780 ms` (`0.0356 ms / 20`) | **`6.85×`** | `maxErr = 1.02e-15` |
| `p=3, n=5, N=243` | `0.010535 ms` (`0.2107 ms / 20`) | `1.79125 ms` (`3.5825 ms / 2`) | **`170.03×`** | `maxErr = 1.12e-14` |
| `p=5, n=4, N=625` | `0.02867 ms` (`0.2867 ms / 10`) | `14.2165 ms` (`14.2165 ms / 1`) | **`495.87×`** | `maxErr = 1.07e-14` |

### Honest Caveats & Small-$N$ / Variance Disclosure (`B27`)

- **Tiny-$N$ overhead:** For trivial sizes like $N = 2$ or $N = 3$, loop overhead and twiddle-table indexing make naive summation competitive; Radix-$p$ wins decisively starting at $N \ge 9$ (`6.85×` at $N=9$, `495.87×` at $N=625$).
- **Thermal & JIT variance:** `min`/`max` ranges on sub-millisecond workloads (e.g. `0.5517 ms`–`1.9367 ms` on `coupled_btz_frame_step`) reflect V8 tier-up and OS scheduling jitter across laptop power states; we therefore report median + IQR rather than cherry-picked minimums.
- **Quadratic visual/spectral ceiling:** Interactive WebGL2 presets stay below $N \le 343$ because the 2D ultrametric matrix/oscilloscope rendering and exact Jacobi diagonalization (in `scripts/discover.mjs`) scale as $O(N^2)$–$O(N^3)$, whereas the core FFT/bulk/RT engine scales as $O(p N \log_p N)$ and $O(V)$.

---

## 4. Historical Performance Tracking (`B26`)

| Release | Key Optimization | Coupled BTZ Frame (`p=3, n=5, L=9`) | Bulk KG+Ricci+RT (`N=625`) | Radix-$p$ FFT (`N=625`) Speedup |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `v1.0.0` | Initial zero-dependency Radix-$p$ FFT & $O(V)$ Schur + Sherman-Morrison solver | Uninstrumented | Uninstrumented | Uninstrumented |
| `v1.3.0` | Cached WebGL2 uniform locations, preallocated scratch TypedArrays in `computeOllivierRicci` / `computeRyuTakayanagi` / `stepGravity` (`_sigmaSnap`) | `< 1 ms` (60 FPS verified in browser) | — | — |
| `v1.4.0` | Formal hardware-tagged median/IQR harness (`scripts/bench.mjs`) + strict input bounds | `0.3882 ms` (IQR `0.1318 ms`) | `0.2223 ms` (SPFA) | `319.89×` (`maxErr=1.07e-14`) |
| `v1.5.0` | Replaced BTZ horizon SPFA with Johnson potential-reduced Dijkstra (`F35`, negative-cycle impossible) + strict JSDoc typed engine | `0.7307 ms` (IQR `0.1875 ms`, `kgRes=1.20e-16`) | `0.1584 ms` (IQR `0.0851 ms`, `kgRes=1.78e-15`) | `445.37×` (`maxErr=1.07e-14`) |
| `v1.6.0` | Added engine defense-in-depth guards (`F41`–`F44`), removed constructor double-allocation (`F42`), and replaced audio foldback loop with $O(1)$ log-space folding (`F65`) | **`0.7485 ms`** (IQR `0.4404 ms`, `kgRes=1.20e-16`) | **`0.1236 ms`** (IQR `0.0369 ms`, `kgRes=1.78e-15`) | **`495.87×`** (`maxErr=1.07e-14`) |

## FILE: `docs/threat-model.md`

# Security Threat Model (`docs/threat-model.md`)

> Build Standard `B36`. STRIDE threat analysis covering ULTRAMETRICA's local HTTP server (`server.mjs`), browser observatory (`src/web/`), mathematical engine (`src/engine/`), and verification toolchain (`lean/`, `scripts/`).

## 1. Trust Boundaries & Attack Surface

| Surface | Exposure | Trust Level | Key Assets |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Local HTTP Server (`server.mjs`)** | Loopback (`127.0.0.1:4173` default) or user-configured LAN `HOST` | Untrusted HTTP request lines / paths / headers | Local filesystem outside `src/`, process availability |
| **Browser Observatory (`src/web/`)** | Public static site (`https://0thernes.github.io/ultrametrica/`) | Untrusted URL query string (`?exp=...&p=...`) | Browser origin integrity, XSS prevention, GPU/Audio stability |
| **Mathematical Engine (`src/engine/`)** | Imported ES modules | Untrusted caller arguments (`p`, `n`, `horizonDepth`, `alpha`) | Memory safety (no unbounded allocation, infinite loops, or NaN poisoning) |
| **Lean 4 Proofs (`lean/`)** | Public repo / external evaluator | Untrusted proof files (`Solution.lean`) | Logical soundness against `Challenge.lean` specification |

---

## 2. STRIDE Threat Matrix & Mitigations

| Category | Specific Threat | Severity | Concrete Mitigation | Automated Verification |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Spoofing** | Forged theorem provenance or tampered release PDF/benchmarks | High | Cryptographic `CHECKSUMS.sha256` & `data/MANIFEST.sha256`, `actions/attest-build-provenance@v2` SLSA release attestation, exact ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`, verbatim README `#print axioms` check | `scripts/verify_exact.py --check-checksums`, `scripts/check_readme_axioms.py`, `.github/workflows/release.yml` |
| **Tampering** | Path traversal (`../../etc/passwd`, `%2e%2e%2f`, backslash `..\`, protocol-relative `//`, ASCII control chars `[\x00-\x1f\x7f]`, or symlink escape inside `src/`) on `server.mjs` | High | Reject `rawUrl.startsWith('//')` (`400`), strict `decodeURIComponent` guard, reject `[\x00-\x1f\x7f\\]` (`400`), canonical `path.resolve` + `path.relative` prefix check (`403`), plus `fsImpl.realpath` symlink-escape confinement (`403`), reject non-files/directories (`403`) | [`test/server.mjs`](../test/server.mjs), [`test/fuzz.mjs`](../test/fuzz.mjs) (`500` fuzzed URLs), [`test/concurrency.mjs`](../test/concurrency.mjs) |
| **Tampering** | DOM-based XSS via crafted URL permalink parameters or injected UI markup | High | Strict `Content-Security-Policy` (`default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'`), zero `innerHTML` usage in `src/web/app.js` and `src/web/blueprint.js` (uses `textContent` / safe DOM/SVG nodes), strict numeric clamping & allowlist checks on URL query params | [`test/server.mjs`](../test/server.mjs) (`SECURITY_HEADERS`), `scripts/check_blueprint.py` |
| **Tampering** | Proof-checking bypass in Lean 4 (hidden `sorry`, `native_decide`, `@[extern`, custom `axiom`, definition mismatch) | Critical | Isolated `Spec.lean` + `Challenge.lean` vs. `Solution.lean` checked via **6 independent kernels** (`lake check --paranoid` + `lake comparator --paranoid` inside Linux `bubblewrap` sandbox) + nested-comment-safe static scanner (`F09`) + `VerifyAxioms.lean` allowlist (`148` audited decls) | `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (`lean4-six-kernel-audit`), `scripts/verify_exact.py` |
| **Repudiation** | Silent modification of preregistered statistical hypotheses or post-hoc editing of published results | Medium | Git-sealed [`docs/preregistration.md`](preregistration.md) (`c171b1b`) committed *before* running `scripts/stats_eval.mjs`, transparent [`DEVIATIONS.md`](../DEVIATIONS.md), append-only [`docs/run-log.md`](run-log.md), and [`ERRATA.md`](../ERRATA.md) | `results/stats-eval.json` (`preregCommit`), git commit history |
| **Information Disclosure** | Accidental leakage of host stack traces or filesystem structure via HTTP responses | Medium | `server.mjs` returns minimal generic plain-text bodies (`Bad Request`, `Forbidden`, `Not Found`, `Internal Server Error`) on all error codes; full stack traces go strictly to structured server-side `stderr` logs | [`test/server.mjs`](../test/server.mjs) (B21 EIO test) |
| **Information Disclosure** | Accidental commit of API keys or tokens | Medium | Zero external API keys required; report-only `gitleaks` secret scan runs on every push in CI | `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (`report-only-static`) |
| **Denial of Service** | Memory exhaustion, `NaN` poisoning, or infinite loop via giant `PadicSpace(p, n)`, hostile `alpha` in audio foldback (`F65`), negative `horizonDepth`, or non-finite `dt`/pivots | High | `PadicSpace` caps $N = p^n \le 65{,}536$; all public engine constructors/methods validate integer/length/finiteness/pivot bounds loudly (`RangeError`/`TypeError`); audio prime-power folding uses exact $O(1)$ log-space math with strict bounds (`alpha in (0, 100]` / `<= 10.0`, fixing real infinite-loop bug `F65`) | [`test/properties.mjs`](../test/properties.mjs), [`test/fuzz.mjs`](../test/fuzz.mjs) (`500` hostile engine/audio fuzz calls) |
| **Denial of Service** | Unhandled `ERR_HTTP_HEADERS_SENT` crash, hung socket, or audio-thread NaN under concurrent traffic + disk `EIO` faults | Medium | `server.mjs` verifies `realpath` and reads file bytes *before* calling `res.writeHead(200, ...)`, guards `res.headersSent` in `catch`, and survives parallel `100`-request + `40`-op `EIO` storms cleanly; `audio-worklet.js` guards every sample with `Number.isFinite` | [`test/server.mjs`](../test/server.mjs), [`test/concurrency.mjs`](../test/concurrency.mjs) (B19 HTTP + AudioWorklet VM storm) |
| **Elevation of Privilege** | Unsupported HTTP verbs (`POST`/`PUT`/`DELETE`) or browser plugin/frame embedding | Low | Strict `GET`/`HEAD` allowlist (`405` + `Allow: GET, HEAD`), `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin`, `frame-ancestors 'none'` | [`test/server.mjs`](../test/server.mjs), [`test/fuzz.mjs`](../test/fuzz.mjs) |

## 3. Out-of-Scope Threats

ULTRAMETRICA is a static client-side scientific observatory and local research server with no user accounts, no authentication database, and no PII collection (`personal_data: false`). It is not designed to be exposed directly to the public internet without TLS termination (public deployment uses GitHub Pages HTTPS).

## FILE: `docs/faq.md`

# Frequently Asked Questions (`docs/faq.md`)

> Build Standard `A44`. Direct, non-evasive answers to skeptical questions from mathematicians, physicists, and reviewers.

### 1. Did ULTRAMETRICA solve any open problems from `0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas`?
**No — `0 / 1,900` full solutions.** A systematic audit of all `1,900` entries in `unsolved-problems-mega-atlas` is archived in [`docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md`](MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md). ULTRAMETRICA contributes formally verified discrete finite-cutoff sub-results related to **`SUB-032`** ($p$-adic AdS/CFT) and an empirical/formal negative result falsifying naive GOE/GUE thermalization in Monna-conjugated adelic hybrids (`ANL-065`/`QM-016`), while leaving continuum limits ($n \to \infty$) and full adelic unification over $\mathbb{A}_{\mathbb{Q}}$ strictly open.

### 2. Why did you avoid Mathlib in the Lean 4 proofs?
Zero Mathlib yields three practical advantages for independent verification: (1) a clean build finishes in **~10 seconds** instead of downloading gigabytes of `.olean` caches; (2) every definition in [`lean/UltrametricaProofs/Spec.lean`](../lean/UltrametricaProofs/Spec.lean) is 100% transparent and readable in `136` lines without navigating deep typeclass hierarchies; and (3) `lake check --paranoid` and `lake comparator --paranoid` verify `Solution.lean` against `Challenge.lean` across **6 independent Lean kernels** (`Lean 4.35.0`, `leanchecker`, `lean4lean`, `nanoda_bin`, `con-leche`, `con-ron`) with zero external dependency bloat. See [`docs/adr/0001-zero-mathlib-lean4.md`](adr/0001-zero-mathlib-lean4.md).

### 3. How do I know the Lean 4 proofs aren't vacuous, bench-maxxed, using `sorry`, or proving watered-down statements?
Four independent defenses prevent proof gaming:
1. **Honest 4-Bucket Accounting (`148` Audited Declarations):** We never inflate declaration totals by double-counting comparator bindings or hiding helper lemmas. Our `148` audited declarations are reported explicitly as **`104` core theorems & corollaries** + **`29` zero-Mathlib helper lemmas** + **`5` adversarial false-variant refutations** (`AdversarialTests.lean`) + **`10` isolated Palomar comparator bindings** (`Challenge.lean` ↔ `Solution.lean`). Every single `.lean` file is `< 1,000` lines.
2. **Verbatim 5-second axiom check:** Run `cd lean && lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean` — every single one of the **148** declarations uses only `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` (zero `sorryAx`, zero `Lean.ofReduceBool`/`native_decide`, zero custom axioms).
3. **Isolated 6-kernel comparator (`Challenge.lean` vs. `Solution.lean`):** `Challenge.lean` imports *only* `Spec.lean` (definitions only, zero proofs), directly specifies tight primal-dual $W_1$ existence (Targets 3 & 7), full arbitrary-dimension $L$ complex Hermitian Sherman-Morrison (Target 5), and concrete kernel-checked non-vacuity witnesses across **all 8** theorem targets (`target_nonvacuity_witnesses`), matched identically against sorry-free `Solution.lean`.
4. **Line-by-line Statement Fidelity Audit:** [`docs/statement-fidelity.md`](statement-fidelity.md) maps every Lean theorem literally to the textbook/paper mathematical statement and states every hypothesis explicitly.

### 4. Does ULTRAMETRICA claim to have discovered new experimental physics?
**No.** All six theorems (Theorems I–VI) are strictly mathematical and computational results on finite $p$-adic groups $\mathbb{Z}_p / p^n\mathbb{Z}_p$ and finite weighted Bruhat-Tits / Tate-curve graphs. See [`LIMITATIONS.md`](../LIMITATIONS.md) for the complete literal-vs-metaphor table.

### 5. Why is the intra-sector spacing ratio $\langle r\rangle$ at $p=5, W_{0,1}$ (`~0.626`) close to GUE (`0.5996`) — didn't you just see GUE chaos?
**No — and our pre-registered Experiment I (`results/stats-eval.json`) decisively falsifies that interpretation.** Inside the *exact same* $p=5, N=625$ Hamiltonian $H_\theta$, sibling sector $W_{0,2}$ locks simultaneously at $\langle r\rangle = 0.2612 \approx 1/4$ (far below even Poisson `0.3863`!), while $W_{0,1}$ sits strictly *above* GUE at $\approx 2/3$ (primary `p_holm = 0.0004`, Mann-Whitney $U$ `p <= 4.8e-7`, Cliff's $\delta = -0.8035$ `[-0.8380, -0.7629]` in $W_{0,2}$ and $+0.2686$ `[+0.1967, +0.3360]` in $W_{0,1}$, $p=2, W_{0,1} \approx 0.0015$ with Cliff's $\delta = -0.9980$, plus non-pseudoreplicated matrix-level sensitivity `K = 20`, exact sign & Wilcoxon `p_holm = 7.63e-6`; see [`DEVIATIONS.md`](../DEVIATIONS.md)). Both values come from the exact formally proved **modular picket-fence law** $r_0(p, m) = \min(2m, p-2m)/\max(2m, p-2m)$ (Proposition 4.2).

### 6. Why isn't this MIT or Apache-2.0 licensed?
The author retains commercial rights under `COSMOGONIC LICENSE — NON-COMMERCIAL RESEARCH & PLAY` ([`LICENSE`](../LICENSE)), while granting broad royalty-free permission for personal, educational, academic, and independent non-commercial research, study, verification, and modification. The trade-off with OSI-requiring venues (e.g., JOSS or Mathlib upstreaming) is recorded explicitly in [`docs/adr/0005-cosmogonic-noncommercial-license.md`](adr/0005-cosmogonic-noncommercial-license.md).

### 7. Why does `README.md` say "Independent Researcher" instead of "0thernes LLC"?
Because no LLC legal entity has been formally registered, we corrected all authorship metadata in `v1.4.0` to match the author's live ORCID record (`Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA`, ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`), keeping `0thernes` strictly as the project/publisher handle. See [`ERRATA.md`](../ERRATA.md).

## FILE: `docs/glossary.md`

# Glossary (`docs/glossary.md`)

> Alphabetized technical, mathematical, and verification glossary (`A44`). Complements the root [`GLOSSARY.md`](../GLOSSARY.md).

- **Adelic Hybrid Hamiltonian ($H_\theta$):** One-parameter real symmetric operator $\theta R_p D_p^\alpha R_p + (1-\theta) H_{\mathbb{R}}$ coupling Monna-conjugated $p$-adic Vladimirov dispersion with circular Archimedean dispersion on $\mathbb{Z}/p^n\mathbb{Z}$.
- **Aharonov-Bohm Horizon Flux ($\Omega$):** Directed $U(1)$ gauge phase $\theta = \Omega/L$ threaded around the $L$-cycle BTZ horizon ring, producing complex Hermitian hopping $-w_e e^{\pm i\theta}$.
- **Blindspot (Finding Class 10/10):** An unexamined assumption, missing axis, or untested invariant class that previous reviews failed to inspect at all.
- **Breitenlohner-Freedman (BF) Bound ($m_{\mathrm{BF}}^2$):** Discrete AdS stability threshold $m_{\mathrm{BF}}^2 = -(\sqrt{p} - 1)^2$ achieved at $\Delta = 1/2$, with exact squared excess $m^2(\Delta) - m_{\mathrm{BF}}^2 = (p^{\Delta/2} - p^{(1-\Delta)/2})^2 \ge 0$.
- **Bruhat-Tits Tree ($T_p$):** Infinite $(p+1)$-regular acyclic graph serving as the discrete hyperbolic bulk dual to $\mathbb{P}^1(\mathbb{Q}_p)$, truncated in simulation to depth $n$ with $N = p^n$ leaves.
- **Bug (Finding Class 1/10):** Incorrect executable code behavior (e.g., `F02` negative `horizonDepth` coercion, `F14` `ERR_HTTP_HEADERS_SENT` in `server.mjs`).
- **Concern (Finding Class 5/10):** A risk or sensitivity that does not currently fail tests but merits monitoring or explicit bounding (e.g., sub-millisecond JIT variance in benchmarks).
- **Conflict (Finding Class 7/10):** A direct contradiction between two documents, specs, versions, or standards.
- **Dilemma (Finding Class 6/10):** A genuine trade-off with no free lunch requiring an explicit recorded owner decision (e.g., Non-Commercial Cosmogonic License vs. OSI license for Mathlib/JOSS).
- **Error (Finding Class 2/10):** A factual, mathematical, build, or runtime failure (e.g., compiler type error, wrong sign, or stale version number).
- **Gap (Finding Class 8/10):** A missing required artifact, test category, or checklist item (e.g., missing lockfile `B02` or missing `Challenge.lean` comparator setup).
- **Hole (Finding Class 9/10):** A structural weakness in a verification or security check that could allow a false positive or bypass (e.g., `F09` non-nested Lean comment regex).
- **Issue (Finding Class 3/10):** An operational, UX, accessibility, or maintainability defect (e.g., missing WCAG `<label for>` or `aria-pressed`).
- **Kantorovich Duality:** Primal-dual equivalence for 1-Wasserstein optimal transport $W_1(\mu_u, \mu_v) = \sup_{\|\phi\|_{\mathrm{Lip}} \le 1} (\langle \phi, \mu_u\rangle - \langle \phi, \mu_v\rangle)$, formalized over exact integers/rationals in `HolographyCurvature.lean`.
- **Kozyrev Wavelet ($\psi_{j,b,m}$):** Orthonormal compactly supported eigenfunction of $D_p^\alpha$ supported strictly on a single $p$-adic ball $B_j(b)$ with eigenvalue $p^{\alpha(j+1)}$ and exact nonlinear soliton invariance (Theorem III).
- **Modular Picket-Fence Law ($r_0(p,m)$):** Exact alternating spacing-ratio ceiling $\min(2m, p-2m)/\max(2m, p-2m)$ inside valuation-residue sector $W_{0,m}$ (Proposition 4.2), falsifying Wigner-Dyson GOE/GUE thermalization.
- **Monna Involution ($R_p$):** Base-$p$ digit-reversal permutation on $\{0,\dots,p^n-1\}$ mapping $p$-adic balls bijectively to contiguous leaf intervals.
- **Ollivier-Ricci Curvature ($\kappa_e$):** Discrete edge curvature $\kappa(u, v) = 1 - W_1(\mu_u, \mu_v)/a_{uv}$ for non-lazy conductance walks $\mu_u(x) = w_{ux} / W_u$.
- **Problem (Finding Class 4/10):** A high-level credibility, governance, or scientific-framing flaw (e.g., unformed `"0thernes LLC"` entity claim).
- **Ryu-Takayanagi (RT) Cut & Strong Subadditivity (SSA):** Exact global minimum homologous edge cut capacity $S(A) = \min_{W \sim A} \sum_{e \in \partial W} c_e$, universally obeying $S(A \cup B \cup C) + S(B) \le S(A \cup B) + S(B \cup C)$ (Theorem VI).
- **Supercritical Pinch Deficit:** Exact negative breakdown $-2\sum_{e: w_e/W_u + w_e/W_v > 1} (\frac{w_e}{W_u} + \frac{w_e}{W_v} - 1)$ of curved AdS Gauss-Bonnet conservation when an interior edge is pinched past $w_e/W_u + w_e/W_v > 1$ (single-edge threshold $\sigma_e^* = -\ln p$, Theorems V & V-Global).
- **Tate-Curve BTZ Quotient ($T_p / p^{h\mathbb{Z}}$):** Discrete genus-1 black hole graph formed by identifying depths $< h$ into a closed horizon ring of circumference $L = p^h \ge 3$ with Euler characteristic $\chi = 0$.
- **Vladimirov Operator ($D_p^\alpha$):** Non-local $p$-adic fractional pseudo-differential operator diagonalized by the Pontryagin Fourier transform with eigenvalues $|\xi_k|_p^\alpha$.
- **Yoshida 4th-Order Integrator:** Symmetric 3-stage symplectic operator splitting achieving $O(\Delta t^4)$ energy error and machine-precision $L^2$ norm conservation.
